滑らかなドット絵アニメーションで描かれるド派手な戦闘を堪能しよう！

放置機能でキャラクターを探索へ送り出し、装備や素材を収集。
放置で集めた素材で、キャラクターを育成・強化してより深い階層へ挑戦しましょう！

■ クリエイティブチーム くまさんが贈る「ドット×放置×ハクスラ」の美少女RPG
はせPを筆頭としたDMM GAMESデザイナーを中心に発足したクリエイティブチーム くまさん。
本作はその第1号作品として、「酒場」という大人なテーマをハイクオリティなアニメーションでお送りします！

・美少女キャラクターが登場するRPGが好き

・放置ゲームや育成ゲームを楽しみたい

・編成や戦略を考えるRPGを遊びたい

Нанимайте мафиози, уличных бойцов, гонщиков, байкеров и подпольных боссов со всего Города грехов. У каждого персонажа своя роль, стиль боя и набор навыков. Комбинируйте урон, защиту, контроль и поддержку, чтобы собрать отряд, который сможет разнести любого противника.

[Сражайтесь без лишней рутины]
Автобой берёт грязную работу на себя. Развивайте персонажей, подбирайте состав команды, усиливайте экипировку и грамотно распределяйте ресурсы, а ваша банда сама разберётся с теми, кто встанет у неё на пути. Уличные стычки, войны за территорию и ежедневные подземелья станут проще и быстрее.

[Забирайте добычу каждый день]
Улицы щедры к тем, кто не боится драки. Проходите ежедневные испытания, побеждайте противников и получайте ресурсы для прокачки команды. Каждая победа усиливает вашу банду, расширяет влияние и приближает вас к вершине криминального мира.

[Постройте преступную империю]
Казино, ночные клубы, подпольный бизнес и грязные деньги: всё это может работать на вас. Развивайте свою организацию, объединяйтесь с другими игроками, укрепляйте синдикат и превращайте уличную банду в настоящую мафиозную империю.

[Живите как настоящий босс]
Дорогие машины, роскошные особняки, горы налички, эффектные спутницы и власть над городом. Наслаждайтесь жизнью на вершине, но помните: чем выше вы поднимаетесь, тем больше желающих сбросить вас вниз.

[Пройдите путь власти и предательства]
Вас ждёт история амбиций, мести, опасных союзов и жестокой борьбы за влияние. Вы встретите союзников и противников, примете непростые решения и сами определите свою судьбу. Останетесь мелким уличным головорезом или станете главным боссом Города грехов?

data.name: Arrow Print: Color Sort Puzzle
data.description_full:
What if a puzzle game could stretch your brain, calm your nerves, and let you watch adorable little ducks take shape right before your eyes?
That's Arrow Print: Color Sort Puzzle.
Moving beyond traditional color-sorting mechanics, Arrow Print brings together two unexpected worlds: path-solving puzzles and 3D printing. You're not just clearing a static grid — you're fueling a working 3D printer waiting for the right materials.
🖨️ More Than a Puzzle — It's a Print Lab
When you open the game, here's what you'll see:
In the workspace above, a few 3D printers sit quietly, each holding an empty mold, ready to bring a duck to life.
Below, a maze of vibrant lines twists and crisscrosses the board. Each one acts as a tube of 3D printing filament, and along every line you'll find directional arrows — waiting for your command.
Your mission: tap the right arrows, route each color along its path, and deliver the material into the matching printer. Once a color is fully delivered, the printer hums to life, building your duck one layer at a time.
That moment — watching a tiny duck slowly take shape — feels a little like childhood, the same joy as watching clay come alive.
🧠 Where's the Challenge?
It looks simple. It isn't:
Multiple colors weave through each other — one wrong tap, and your paths tangle.
Short routes often block longer ones — plan your order, or stay stuck.
In later levels, a single arrow can change the flow of an entire line.
Stuck? Hint bulbs light up a safe move when you need one.
Every level feels like unraveling a colorful ball of yarn — find the right thread to pull, and the whole puzzle opens up.
🌿 Designed for Calm Minds
We built Arrow Print to be the little reset button in your day — for commutes, lunch breaks, or those last quiet minutes before sleep:
No timer — think as slowly as you like.
No energy system — play for one minute or even for one hour.
Play offline — works on planes, subways, anywhere.
Soft visuals — neon lines on dark backgrounds, easy on the eyes.
Soothing sounds — every successful print rewards you with a gentle chime.
✨ Who Will Love It?
Puzzle fans who want a brain workout without time pressure.
Suckers for cute, soothing visuals.
Busy people looking for a mindful pocket of calm.
Gamers wanting an accessible puzzle that all skill levels can play together.
Curious players who just couldn't resist the idea of a 3D-printing duck game.
🌈 Start Your Arrow Print Journey
Tap your first arrow. Watch the color start to flow. The moment your first little duck takes shape, you'll know — this one's different.

data.name: Slide Arrows Match
data.description_full:
"Slide Arrows Match" is an addictive logic puzzle game. The game screen is a grid filled with colored arrows, each pointing in a different direction. Your goal is to tap these arrows, causing them to move in the direction they point, until all arrows are off the screen. Sounds simple? Don't underestimate it—the difficulty increases as you progress!

Game Features
Basic Controls: Tap to select an arrow, and the arrow will move in the direction it points.If an arrow collides with another arrow in its forward direction, it will lose one health point. You have three health points; once you run out, you must start over.
Guidance: Each arrow in the game has an extension line indicating its forward direction.
Four different game color schemes are available to suit different gaming preferences.

Slide Rules:
Arrows can only move in the direction they point.
Only one arrow can be moved at a time.
Arrows cannot pass through other arrows.
Winning Condition: Win the level when all arrows on the board are off the screen.

How to Play
Start from the Edges: Focus on aligning arrows to the edges first—they have fewer movement options and are easier to lock onto.
You'll love it for its clean, minimalist visual design paired with vibrant arrow colors. Relaxing background music and satisfying sliding sound effects. Hundreds of progressively challenging levels. Suitable for all ages—the perfect choice for commuting, mental training, or relaxation. Ready to match? Whether you want to kill time on your commute, exercise your logic, or simply enjoy a light yet challenging puzzle game, Slide Arrows Match is for you. Research shows that playing these spatial reasoning puzzles helps improve planning skills and mental agility! Challenge yourself—how fast can you finish them all?

data.name: Vita Sort
data.description_full:
Vita Sort - Exclusive Puzzle, Strategic Categorization
Vita Sort is an exclusive Mahjong tile categorization puzzle game. We are thrilled to present this fresh title that blends classic Mahjong visual art with innovative gameplay. Featuring clear, large Mahjong tiles and a user-friendly interface compatible with phones, our goal is to provide a relaxing yet mentally engaging experience for all players, particularly focused on older adults.
How to Play Vita Sort:
Playing Vita Sort is intuitive, with its core mechanics centered around your meticulous observation, clever categorization, and strategic tapping to effectively manage the tiles and collection areas.
1. Tap to Collect: Tap any available Mahjong tile on the board, and it will first move into the temporary tray at the bottom.
2. Activate & Categorize:
- The top of the screen features 3 main category slots, displaying active Mahjong tile categories and their collection progress (e.g., "Characters 2/4").
- When a Mahjong tile enters the temporary tray, if it belongs to a category already represented in one of the main category slots, all matching tiles in the tray will automatically categorize and count towards that main slot's progress.
- If the tile belongs to a new major category and there's an empty main category slot at the top, that new category will be activated and occupy a slot.
3. Complete & Clear: Once the number of Mahjong tiles in a main category slot reaches its target requirement, that category will be fully collected and disappear from the slot, freeing up space for new categories.
4. Strategic Planning: The temporary tray has limited space. You need to plan your taps in advance, ensuring each tap effectively contributes to completing a main category. Avoid filling the tray with too many un-categorizable tiles, which could lead to a stalled game.
5. Clear the Board Challenge: Your ultimate goal is to use your wisdom to gradually clear all Mahjong tiles from the board, successfully completing each level!
Exclusive Vita Sort Game Features:
- "Tile Fusion Sort" Innovative Gameplay: Moving beyond traditional matching, we introduce the unique "Tile Fusion Sort" innovative gameplay. This is more than just simple sorting; it's a comprehensive test of your ability to quickly identify, precisely categorize, and strategically plan your moves.
- Classic Mahjong Art Style: The game features classic Mahjong tile visuals, paired with hundreds of meticulously designed board layouts, offering a familiar yet fresh visual feast.
- Large-Scale, Easy-to-Read Design: Designed with players in mind, we use large, clear, and easy-to-read Mahjong tiles and text, allowing you to say goodbye to the strain of small fonts and fully enjoy a comfortable game.
- Mentally Engaging Levels: Each level is thoughtfully designed to activate your mind, helping you enhance your categorization thinking, observation skills, concentration, and short-term memory in a relaxed and enjoyable atmosphere.
- Super Combo Experience: When you cleverly strategize to trigger a continuous collection and elimination of many Mahjong tiles in one go, you'll unlock a thrilling Super Combo, gaining extraordinary game satisfaction and rewards!
- Helpful Auxiliary Tools: The game provides free and useful tools, such as the Undo function to correct mistakes, and the Shuffle tool to open up new possibilities, helping you overcome challenging situations.
- Offline Mode: Full offline support lets you immerse yourself in the fun of Vita Sort anytime, anywhere, without needing an internet connection.
Vita Sort is a meticulously crafted puzzle masterpiece designed for players who love strategic categorization and visual puzzle-solving games.
Note: This is a puzzle game in the style of Mahjong tiles, focused on categorization. It does not contain the rules of traditional Mahjong, Mahjong Solitaire, or other types of card games. The term “Mahjong” here refers solely to the visual style of the tiles.

Core gameplay works offline. Online features such as analytics, ads, remote configuration, and optional Market messages are used only when a connection is available. Players can choose whether to enable local reminders or Market messages.

The app can follow the device language or use a fixed language from Settings. Manual language options include Indonesian, English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Malay, French, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Thai, and Vietnamese. Uzbek and Kazakh are also supported through system-language detection.

Key features:
- Cute collectible tile skin themes to unlock and mix
- Plays fully offline — no internet connection required
- Free to play — no in-app purchases
- 90 short levels with increasing challenge
- Local level progress saving, no sign-up required
- Free in-game points earned through play, Today's Order, Daily Special Order, Market Reward, and optional rewarded ads
- Separate controls for background music and sound effects
- Helpful boosters such as Hammer, Shuffle, and Extra Moves
- Line Specials and Color Bombs for satisfying clear moments

data.name: CrisisX LITE
data.description_full:
Enjoy broader hardware compatibility and smoother gameplay in CrisisX Lite

A deadly mysterious virus outbreak wiped out most of the population within a few days, and the unknown infection continues to spread. People fled in chaos into the streets, only to realize that their homes had transformed into a post-apocalyptic wasteland, with toxic mutants and zombies roaming the city. Infrastructure is destroyed, and society and civilization have completely collapsed. Families were separated when fleeing into the wilderness.
Now, in this devastating doomsday, you are on your own! "SURVIVE" is the only thing that matters. How much longer can you make it out there?

▶ The world is yours to discover! ◀
Embark on your unknown adventure by creating a realistic self-avatar and exploring every inch of a unique, wide-open world with one of the largest maps ever developed. Raid cities, bunkers, and other locations teeming with terrifying walking dead, or explore freezing cold forests in the highlands. The game mechanics restore realistic geographic and climate conditions in North America, enabling you to experience different environments, landscapes, weather, and time zones. Confront numerous unexpected and serious tasks in a life after the end of the world, and build yourself a last shelter in this fallen continent!

▶ New order & rules must be established! ◀
Survival of the fittest! Test your survival skills by finding food and water, and collecting essential but rare materials left from the civilized world. Scavenge resources through activities like cutting trees, mining, hunting, gathering, and fishing to gain enough leverage for surviving the last days and perhaps establishing yourself as the most powerful among the last survivors. After all, only the strongest will endure in the light of day!

▶ Knives out, fight or fight! ◀
Exterminate crowds of mutated zombies and shoot down threatening monsters of all kinds. Each infected individual has a different appearance and attacking pattern depending on its mutation routes. As the last survivor, observe and employ a wise strategy to eliminate and escape the state of decay!
Your most formidable enemies are other surviving human players! Do not blindly venture into the dead; instead, grip your weapon tightly, be vigilant, and keep your eyes open for other survivalists passing by, whether engaging in a 1vs1 battle or an alliance battle. The distinction between a loyal friend and a dangerous intruder is often a fine line.

▶ Together, we thrive! ◀
Gain a foothold first by constructing yourself a shelter and exploiting resources through activities like taming horses, building, planting, and breeding. Ally with other survivors, restore a community, and expand in this zombie apocalypse. Fight side by side with your fellow survivors to resist enemy attacks. Only together can we survive in the last days on Earth!

▶ Uncover the mystery behind the end of the world! ◀
On this action packed journey of survival, you’ll be facing different tasks, puzzles and riddles. Solve them to expose the truth of the shattered world and save the dying light of the civilization. Perhaps the destruction of the fallen humanity was not an accident! You may also find more clues to trace your family’s whereabouts!
CRISIS X is YOUR LAST CHANCE OF SURVIVAL!

PLEASE NOTE
Network connection is required.

Download Arrow Elimination and find out.

全圖鑒收集講究緣分，緣分到來誰也擋不住。抽卡無需繁瑣儀式，不用焚香沐浴、不看時辰風水，指尖輕輕一劃，英靈自動排隊前來歸順。滿倉只是起步，養到會進化才是真正本領！

還在苦研複雜進化路線？我們的養成邏輯簡單直接。輕鬆培養即可快速變強，一路橫掃對手毫無壓力。每隻骷髏都能花式「進化」—— 從灰撲撲小骨頭變成青熒到發光骷髏王，外型與實力雙重飛升，進化之路永無止境～

他人絞盡腦汁研究陣容，我們的小骷髏只有隨心所欲。戰力擔當、輸出核心、防禦大將隨意組合，流派套路自由切換，無需死抄作業，不被固定玩法束縛。輕鬆搭配即可橫掃戰場，你的戰術你做主，魔界任你馳騁！

【稱王有坦途：從骨到王，輕鬆無壓】
開局只是一隻無人在意的小骷髏，全程佛系養成、花式進化、隨心搭配。輕輕鬆鬆晉升魔界戰神。讓整個魔界都知道 —— 輕鬆是態度，養成才是王道！

data.name: Kingdom Fall: Zombie Defense
data.description_full:
The kingdom that stood for centuries has fallen within weeks. A mysterious plague swept through the land, turning the dead into mindless monsters that devour everything in their path. Castles lie in ruins, villages are abandoned, and the few survivors who remain have lost all hope. But you refuse to surrender.

As a brave Lord leading a band of desperate survivors, you must rebuild from the ashes, recruit legendary heroes, and defend your stronghold against endless waves of undead that hunger for the living. In this dark age where betrayal and desperation reign, your courage and tactical brilliance will determine whether your people see another sunrise.

Kingdom Fall is a game of valor, strategy, and resilience. Every choice shapes your kingdom's destiny and your legacy as a leader. Will you focus on fortifying your castle walls and training elite defenders, or will you venture into the cursed lands to reclaim lost territories and uncover the source of the plague? The dead are rising, darkness spreads across the realm, and your people look to you for salvation! Do you have what it takes to restore the kingdom's glory?

Build Your Medieval Stronghold: Construct and upgrade castles, barracks, farms, and defensive structures to create an impregnable fortress. Manage resources wisely and transform your humble refuge into a thriving kingdom.

Recruit Powerful Heroes: Summon valiant knights, cunning rogues, powerful mages, and skilled archers to fight under your banner. Promote and equip them with legendary weapons and armor to lead your armies to victory.

Defend Against the Undead Hordes: Fortify your defenses with towers and elite guards. Command your forces in tactical battles against relentless zombie sieges that grow stronger with each passing night.

Forge Mighty Alliances: Unite with Lords from across the realm to form powerful alliances. Coordinate strategies, share resources, and wage epic wars against rival factions competing for control of the shattered kingdom.

DUST: Dirt ATV Offroad Racing is a 3D ATV racing game where you race through dirt, mud, and extreme offroad tracks. Built for fans of racing games, 4x4 off road action, quad bike racing, and offroad racing, this simulator puts you on a powerful ATV made for rough roads.

Start your engine and ride through dust, speed, traction, and control. Every race takes place on dirt tracks, muddy tracks, bumpy roads, mountain tracks, and rough terrain where every turn can change the result. DUST: Dirt ATV Offroad Racing is focused on ATV racing, quad racing, four wheeler racing, and all terrain vehicle action.

Feel the power of a 3D racing simulator built around ATV handling. Keep your balance on muddy tracks, control speed on dirt, and push through extreme offroad sections. The road is never smooth: climb hills, take sharp corners, jump over bumps, hold traction, and stay ahead until the finish line.

DUST: Dirt ATV Offroad Racing gives you fast races, racing challenge events, dirt track racing routes, mud racing sections, and offroad racing missions. Compete against opponents, overtake rival racers, and fight for first place on every quad route. Race through dusty roads, master every trail, and become the racing master of every competition.

Upgrade your ATV to improve speed, handling, suspension, grip, and acceleration. Every upgrade helps your four wheeler stay stable on rough terrain and faster on dirt roads. Use upgrades to improve your quad bike for harder races, better control, and stronger performance across every offroad challenge. Customize your ATV and tune your ride for every racing style.

If you love racing games, simulator games, 3D racing games, offroad games, dirt racing games, and extreme racing, DUST: Dirt ATV Offroad Racing gives you a focused ATV experience. Enjoy quad bike speed, mud, dirt, rough roads, opponents, competitions, and 4x4 off road racing action.

Ride through dusty roads, rough roads, mud, dirt tracks, hill racing routes, uphill racing sections, and off road racing tracks made for real off roading action. Realistic physics make every surface feel different. Mud slows you down, hills test power, bumps test balance, and sharp turns test your racing skill.

Push rival ATVs, knock opponents off the track, and use every turn to take the lead. In DUST: Dirt ATV Offroad Racing, you ride alone only on tutorial levels. After that, every race becomes a real competition where opponents challenge your speed, control, and offroad driving skills.

data.name: 凹嗚殺：狼人在身邊
data.description_full:
凹嗚...嗚...嗚...
嘘.....小鎮的迷霧中，誰在說謊？

《凹嗚殺：狼人在身邊》是一款燒腦沉浸式推理解謎遊戲，你將化身偵探警長，踏入迷霧籠罩的謊言小鎮。這裡的每個居民都戴著面具，每段對話都可能暗藏玄機，而你，要靠著邏輯與細心，揪出藏在其中的真相。

-遊戲特色-
【與角色對話，在字裡行間捕捉線索】
眾多NPC各有獨立故事與行為邏輯，談話中的閃爍其詞、細節的偏差，都可能成為揭穿偽裝的關鍵線索。點擊角色就能標記「好人」或「狼人」，標對就能解鎖新提示，全程沒有複雜操作，新手也能輕輕鬆鬆上手。

【邏輯為刃，識破偽裝者】
狼人潛伏在好人之中，用言語編織騙局。遊戲以邏輯排除法為核心，透過交叉驗證線索、串聯關鍵信息，靠著嚴謹推理，就能撕開謊言，讓真相浮出水面。

【多重謎題，每一步都決定結局】
從對話選擇到線索拼合，每個決策都會影響調查方向。多重關卡逐級升級，每局2-5分鐘就能完成，純文字推理燒腦又解压，適合碎片時間玩，揪出所有狼人，才能驅散迷霧，守護小鎮。

《凹嗚殺：狼人在身邊》——真相，從來不只一面。
挑戰你的推理極限，在真話與謊言之間，做出最終審判，一起走進這場充滿玄機的文字迷宮吧。

As the game progresses, everything speeds up — signals become harder to read, and deceptive moments are introduced to test your confidence and discipline.

Сhісkеn Rоаd rewards calm thinking under pressure. There is no complex progression, no unnecessary mechanics, only a clean loop of prediction, outcome, and consequence. Each run becomes a personal challenge to stay sharp longer than before, beat your previous streak, and master the rhythm of rapid decisions. It’s a short-session experience that feels intense, focused, and surprisingly addictive.

Đạo Sĩ Bắt Trương Phi: Vua Bùa Chú #1 Việt Nam

Một cõi giới ngập tràn tà khí dần hé mở, nơi quỷ thần lẩn khuất trong từng khoảng không và những pháp trận bùng sáng giữa màn sương đặc quánh. - 6 loại trận đồ - 9 ô chiến thuật - 69 kiểu chơi
Sở hữu 6 loại trận đồ biến hóa, kết hợp cùng 9 ô chiến thuật linh hoạt, người chơi có thể tự do sáng tạo đến 69 kiểu vận hành đội hình khác nhau. Mỗi cách sắp xếp là một thế trận riêng với quy luật khắc chế, mỗi sự thay đổi là một bước xoay chuyển cục diện - nơi tư duy chiến thuật quyết định thắng bại, không chỉ sức mạnh đơn thuần.

- Chưa vào game – Chưa biết thế nào là mãn nhãn.
Đồ họa quỷ thần được khắc họa đầy ám ảnh và choáng ngợp, từ pháp trận rực linh hỏa đến những thực thể hắc hóa phủ đầy tà khí. Mỗi khung hình đều dày đặc hiệu ứng, ánh sáng và chuyển động sống động, tạo nên cảm giác như đang bước vào một thế giới ma mị u ám thực thụ. Chưa đặt chân vào game - chưa thể cảm nhận hết thế nào là mãn nhãn.

- Thí luyện vô hạn tầng - Sai hệ dừng bước - Đúng hệ lên đỉnh.
Leo Tháp Ngũ Hệ Vô Tận là hành trình thí luyện không hồi kết giữa màn sương tà khí dày đặc. Mỗi tầng tháp là một thử thách khắc nghiệt của ngũ hành tương khắc - chọn sai hệ, lập tức dừng bước; chọn đúng hệ, phá ấn mà tiến lên đỉnh cao. Trong không gian u ám và ma lực bủa vây, chỉ những đạo sĩ am hiểu thiên đạo mới đủ sức bước tiếp qua vô hạn tầng tháp.

- Game "chiều" đạo sĩ nhất: Chơi mỗi ngày - tặng ngay VIP 6
Giữa thế giới tà khí u ám, đạo sĩ không đơn độc trên hành trình trấn ấn quỷ thần. Phúc lợi dày đặc trải dài theo từng cấp độ, đặc biệt tặng miễn phí VIP 6 chỉ cần chăm chỉ đăng nhập mỗi ngày. data.name: ドラゴンブラッド：スレイヤーズ学院
data.description_full:
累計発行部数3000万部、全世界で爆発的な人気を誇るファンタジー小説「龍族」が群像劇RPGで登場！
AIアシスタント搭載、魅力的なキャラで爽快バトル、新たなIFルートで運命を廻せ！

▼没入感の高いストーリーとIFストーリー
世界中で大人気の原作小説を元に構築した300万文字を超える濃厚なストーリー。
豪華声優陣の熱演によりさまざまな名場面や名台詞を再現。
本作だけのオリジナルIFルートを多数実装し、全キャラとデートも可能に！
原作では描かれなかった未知なる可能性を、あなたの手で体験しよう！

▼今なら最大400連分無料ガチャ！ログインだけで全キャラ解放のチャンス！
キャラクターの収集ハードルは低めに設定！
ログインボーナスでは、恒常・限定を問わず多くのキャラクターが入手可能！
イベント報酬も充実！ 魅力的なキャラを仲間に迎え絆を深めよう！

▼セミオート王道RPG×策略×爽快バトル
キャラクターの編成や絆の発動など、あなたの戦略次第でバトルはより楽しく奥深く変化する！
オートプレイモードもあるので、カジュアルにも楽しめる！
キャラクターごとにバトル中の専用演出もあるので、爽快感UP！
策略を駆使して、言霊を放て！

▼デイリーミッションはAIにお任せ！
ゲーム内にはAI助手“ノルマ”を実装。
ボタンひとつで面倒なデイリーミッションなどをAIがオールクリア。キャラ育成も超簡単。
より快適に、より自由に、ストレスフリーで『ドラガク』を楽しめる！

▼世界を広げる豊富なイベントとコンテンツ
バトルやメインストーリー以外にも、数多くのミニゲームやサブストーリーを実装！
月毎にイベントも実装し、さまざまな角度から『ドラガク』の世界をディープに遊びつくそう！

▼豪華なサウンドと演出
テーマ曲《IVORY TOWER》はさまざまなアニメやドラマのサウンドを手掛ける澤野弘之氏が担当。
さらに美麗なキャラクター、迫力あるCG演出、Live2Dによる繊細な動きが、新たな『龍族』の世界へあなたを導きます！
豪華声優陣が続々出演（五十音順）
石川界人、伊東健人、小倉唯、鬼頭明里、黒沢ともよ、小林裕介、関根瞳、能登麻美子、広瀬裕也、堀江瞬、前野智昭 他（敬称略）

▼ストーリー
遥か昔、この星は【黒の龍王】ニードホッグを創造した。
そして【黒の龍王】は、【白の龍王】をはじめとするすべての竜の始祖となった。
【黒の龍王】は錬金術と言霊で人間たちを支配し、この世界に君臨した。
その後、【黒の龍王】は四大君主と呼ばれる4対の龍王を創造し、【白の龍王】は人間との間に多くの混血種たちを残した。
世界は竜族を中心に廻っているかのように見えたが……
ある日、【黒の龍王】が暗殺されたことで世界は一変した。
これこそが、竜族と人間、そして混血種たちの気の遠くなるほど長い歴史のはじまりだった。
さまざまな思惑が錯綜する世界で、竜の討伐を目的としたカッセル学院を舞台に、新たな運命の輪が廻り始める。

data.name: Crazy Merge 2048
data.description_full:
Crazy Merge 2048 is a highly addictive and classic number puzzle game! Slide your finger across the board to move the tiles. Whenever two tiles with the same number touch, they merge into one with double the value. Keep combining your way up the chain—2, 4, 8, 16... all the way to the ultimate goal of 2048. It’s easy to learn but incredibly hard to master, providing endless brain-teasing fun!
How to Play:
Swipe to Move: Swipe up, down, left, or right to slide all the tiles on the board in that direction.
Merge Numbers: When two identical numbers collide, they combine into a single new tile with their sum.
Reach 2048: Keep merging strategically to create higher-value tiles and achieve the 2048 goal.
Don't Get Stuck: Plan your moves carefully! If the board fills up and no more merges can be made, it's game over.
Ready to test your logic? Start sliding in Crazy Merge 2048 now

data.name: โลกสวนดอกไม้ของฉัน
data.description_full:
เกมปลูกดอกไม้สุดฮิตที่ผู้เล่นทั่วโลกหลงรัก เตรียมเปิดให้บริการในไทยอย่างเป็นทางการวันที่ 3 มิถุนายน!
กิจกรรมเล่นเกมลุ้นรับดอกไม้จริงเปิดให้ร่วมสนุกได้ตลอด พร้อมจัดส่งตรงถึงบ้านสำหรับผู้เล่นในประเทศไทย!

โลกสวนดอกไม้ของฉันเป็นเกมจำลองสถานการณ์ที่ผ่อนคลายและเยียวยาจิตใจ ที่นี่คุณจะได้พบเพื่อนรักดอกไม้มากมาย และสร้างสังคมเพื่อนรักดอกไม้ของคุณเอง
เกมนี้เล่นง่าย เริ่มต้นได้ทันที ทุกครั้งที่ปลูกดอกไม้ก็มีความตื่นเต้นเล็กๆ รอคุณอยู่ เราอยากมอบความโรแมนติกจากโลกเสมือนมาสู่มือคุณจริงๆ!

〓 โชคดีมาแล้ว ‧ ดอกไม้สดส่งฟรีถึงบ้าน 〓
ความโรแมนติกสุดพิเศษสำหรับคุณ! เพียงปลูกดอกไม้ในเกม เมื่อเก็บเกี่ยวดอกไม้ที่โตเต็มที่ คุณมีโอกาสได้รับการ์ดอวยพรดอกไม้ และแลกเป็นช่อดอกไม้สดส่งตรงถึงบ้านฟรีเลย!

〓 ปลูกดอกไม้สบายๆ ‧ สร้างสวนเฉพาะของคุณ 〓
ในสวนเฉพาะของคุณ ปลูกดูแลกล้วยไม้ ลีลาวดี ดอกมะลิ และดอกไม้มากมายด้วยมือคุณเอง เพลิดเพลินกับช่วงเวลาการปลูกที่ผ่อนคลายและบำบัดใจ ปล่อยวางความเครียดทีละนิด พร้อมสัมผัสความอบอุ่นจากเพื่อนดอกไม้ที่อยู่เคียงข้าง

〓 สนุกกับเพื่อน ‧ คลายเครียดด้วยสังคมเกม 〓
ในสวนไม่มีคำว่าเหงา! ผูกมิตรกับเพื่อนซี้ เข้าร่วมกิลด์ เยี่ยมชมสวนเพื่อน หรือแม้แต่ "แอบขโมย" ดอกไม้จากเพื่อนได้ด้วย! สัมผัสประสบการณ์การเล่นที่สนุกสนานและผ่อนคลาย ทุกการพบเจอคือความประหลาดใจ

〓 ศิลปะการจัดดอกไม้ ‧ สร้างสรรค์ชีวิตมีระดับ 〓
ดอกไม้ที่เก็บเกี่ยวไม่ได้มีไว้ชมเท่านั้น แต่ยังจัดแต่งได้อย่างอิสระ ผสมผสานแจกันและดอกไม้หลากหลายชนิด สร้างสรรค์ผลงานจัดดอกไม้ของคุณเอง ตั้งแต่เลือกสีสันไปจนถึงสไตล์ ออกแบบสุนทรียภาพที่เป็นเอกลักษณ์เฉพาะตัว

〓 บริหารร้านดอกไม้ ‧ สัมผัสชีวิตเจ้าของร้าน 〓
รับออเดอร์ จัดทำ ขาย ขยายร้านดอกไม้ของคุณทีละขั้นตอน สร้างร้านดอกไม้ยอดนิยมของคุณอย่างค่อยเป็นค่อยไป ใช้กลยุทธ์การบริหารเพื่อเพิ่มรายได้ ให้สวนและร้านค้าเติบโตไปพร้อมกัน

〓 สัตว์เลี้ยงแสนน่ารัก ‧ เยียวยาใจเป็นสองเท่า 〓
ดูแลน้องแมวน่ารักในบ้านแมว ให้อาหาร ลูบไล้ ตกแต่งพื้นที่ส่วนตัว เพลิดเพลินกับช่วงเวลาแห่งความอบอุ่นที่มีเพื่อนซี้สี่ขาอยู่เคียงข้าง!

Needles streaming in from every angle. Balloons drifting through the air.

Strike first with a quick jab. Hold the line with a steady defense. Catch your opponent with a perfectly-timed counter.
Every choice carries weight.
Pull out your phone anywhere — at a cafe, on the train, at a campsite, in bed before sleep.
With one phone, you and a friend, family member, or partner can settle a duel in seconds.
Who's faster. Who's cooler under pressure.
The answer comes in under a minute.

Shield in one hand, needle in the other

Stuns and balloon pops
A needle to the balloon ends it instantly. A needle to the arm or body locks you in a brief stun.
One moment of hesitation decides the fight. Will you find their opening, or refuse to show one yourself?
Every choice is in your hands.

Hold your needle back to charge up energy. When the meter fills, aim, release, and unleash a piercing strike.
In Survival, it lets you skewer a whole line of balloons in one satisfying shot. In Duel, it breaks through your opponent's defense by force.
Land a Charging Shot and your opponent's blocking arm is stunned no matter what, while their shield takes heavy damage and eventually shatters from repeated hits.
It's the trump card that breaks defensive players and flips the match in an instant.

Your shield isn't invincible. Take enough heavy hits and it cracks, then shatters. Block, dodge, or counter — every choice decides the match.

Enjoy games of reflexes and split-second judgment

data.name: Рlinkо Drop
data.description_full:
Рlinkо Drop is a precision-driven arcade challenge where gravity does the moving and you shape the outcome. A falling ball begins its journey through a field of pins, bouncing unpredictably as it descends. Your role is limited but critical: a single movable platform, placed at the right moment, can completely change the result.

Each round is a test of judgment rather than speed. You must read the ball’s path, anticipate how the pins will scatter it, and decide when to intervene. One well-timed adjustment can guide the ball toward success; a rushed move wastes your chance. As rounds progress, the descent accelerates and the environment becomes less reliable, forcing sharper focus and faster decisions.

Рlinkо Drop thrives on restraint. You can’t control everything — only influence the fall. Targets shift after every success, preventing routine and rewarding adaptability. Subtle changes in the field keep each attempt fresh, while the pressure of consecutive wins raises the stakes.

Designed for short but intense sessions, Рlinkо Drop blends calm observation with sudden commitment. It’s not about constant action, but about making the one move that matters. Can you trust your timing when gravity won’t wait?

data.name: Number Stitch
data.description_full:
Number Stitch is a relaxing ASMR game that blends number coloring with the warm art of weaving. Tap and drag across the grid to match the right areas – each fill instantly reveals a realistic stitch texture. Watch an empty hoop transform into a textured handmade piece. Whether you love coloring or just need a quiet way to unwind, this game delivers the simple joy of stitching something lovely with your own hands.
Gameplay Overview
Enter the level. As you drag, the selected area fills with color and texture immediately – release to complete the fill and stitch. Each numbered cell represents a target count. You must enclose exactly that many cells without overlapping already filled areas. Multiple hoop sections appear together, so you need to plan your fill order and layout to perfectly match all numbers. No timers, no penalties – just peaceful thinking and a soothing filling rhythm. Complete a hoop and your artwork is saved to your Collection Album to browse anytime. Daily challenges bring new patterns and goals, unlocking more stitch textures and themed sets.
Key Features
- Realistic Stitch Texture: Every fill isn't a flat color block but a clear woven texture. From fine flat stitches to plush yarn feels, each piece looks truly embroidered.
- Soothing ASMR Play: Drag, fill, release – every action comes with gentle sounds and subtle haptic feedback. The soft weaving sound as the thread covers the grid is deeply calming.
- Rich Content & Collection: Many hoop patterns await, from cute animals to beautiful landscapes. Completed works are automatically added to your Collection Album, building your own woven gallery. Daily challenges refresh often, unlocking more textures and themes.
- Strategic Layout, Easy to Learn: Simple tap and drag to fill, but as levels progress, multiple hoop sections interlock. You'll need clever planning of fill order and area distribution to perfectly complete each artwork.
Why You'll Love It
- Blends the fun of number coloring with the warm texture of weaving – both brain challenge and handmade therapy.
- No timers, no penalties – quiet filling and free retries, perfect for any relaxing moment.
- Fresh goals and little surprises every time you open – always something to brighten your day.
Ready to Stitch Your First Masterpiece?
Download Number Stitch. Tap, drag, fill, and weave – let every thread find its place. Enjoy the cozy ASMR sounds as you slowly embroider your own art album.

data.name: Crowd Bus Jam
data.description_full:
🚌 Match the Passengers, Fill the Buses! 🚌

Your mission: get every waiting passenger onto the right bus. Sounds simple? Wait until you see the crowd. The platform can hold up to 64 passengers at once — and they keep coming in batches of 12.

🎨 Match by Color
Each passenger has a color. Each bus also has a color. A red passenger can only board a red bus. No exceptions. You’ll need to keep an eye on the platform and match colors carefully.

🚍 8 Seats per Bus
Every bus fits exactly 8 passengers. That means you can’t just throw random people on board. You have to fill each bus completely with the right color before it leaves.

🧠 Plan Your Platform
Passengers arrive in batches of 12. If you don’t match them quickly, the platform fills up. Once it hits 64, no more passengers can arrive — and if there’s no space for the next batch… game over. You’ll need to balance which buses to call and which colors to prioritize.

🌈 More Colors, More Chaos
As you level up, more colors appear. Passengers come in trickier patterns. The platform gets crowded fast. You’ll need quick decisions and a sharp memory to keep everything moving.

🏆 Can You Clear the Platform?
The goal is simple: get every passenger on a bus before the platform overflows. No timer, but every batch adds pressure. One wrong bus choice and you might block yourself for good.

Ready to become the ultimate dispatch master? Match those colors, fill those buses, and clear the queue! 🚦🔴🔵🟡🟢🚌

data.name: Rоyаl Fruіts Spіn
data.description_full:
Rоyаl Fruіts Spіn is a colorful arcade challenge where timing, focus, and luck come together in a fast-paced spinning experience. Three vertical reels filled with vibrant fruits and rare symbols rotate nonstop, and your goal is to stop each column at the perfect moment to create winning combinations along the center line.

Every round tests your reactions and precision. Tap the reels one by one to lock their position and match identical symbols in the middle row. Cherries, lemons, grapes, and watermelons bring progress, while the rare crown symbol unlocks the chance for a powerful Royal Win. Even partial matches can help you move forward, but perfect combinations are the key to victory.

As the game continues, the reels spin faster and become harder to control, demanding sharper timing and better concentration. Some columns may continue moving slightly after a tap, adding an extra layer of challenge and unpredictability to every spin. To win, you must achieve three successful full matches in a row or land three crowns in a single attempt before mistakes or the timer end your run.

With bright visuals, dynamic gameplay, and satisfying reaction-based mechanics, Rоyаl Fruіts Spіn delivers an exciting arcade experience packed with energy, tension, and rewarding moments.

data.name: 咲庭 ~ひとりの花商い~
data.description_full:
『咲庭～ひとりの花商い～』は、園藝シミュレーション・経営型の癒し系ソーシャルゲームです。ゲーム内で数百種類の花を育てて収穫し、自由に組み合わせて美しい生花作品を作り上げたり、様々なテーマ装飾に変更して自分だけの花屋や庭園を彩ったりできます。

楽しく花を育てて収穫するだけで、リアルな花束がご自宅に届きます。ゲームのロマンを現実に！

〓 お花の生け花 〓
華やかな花を収穫したら、創造力を活かして生け花に挑戦！
自分のセンスで花器を選び、花を自由に組み合わせ、素敵な作品を作り上げましょう。
作品を展示・販売して、達成感を味わうこともできます。

〓 賑わう花市場 〓
花商いを利益につなげたいなら、注文に対応しましょう！
毎日たくさんの「住民注文」「仕立注文」「団体注文」などが届きます。
条件通りに完成させれば、金貨や経験値を獲得可能。
売上を伸ばすには、経営センスを発揮してキャンセル率を減らすことが大切です。

〓 花での出会い 〓
他のプレイヤーと友達になり、ギルドを結成して、楽しく交流できます。
友達になれば、お互いの庭を訪問したり、花を摘ませてあげたり、楽しい「花拾い」を楽しむことも。
花門会内では花門大会も開催され、上位入賞すれば豪華報酬が獲得できます。

〓 ペットハウス 〓
専用エリア「みかん小院」では、いつでもお気に入りのペットをなでたり、抱っこしたり、ご飯をあげたりできます。
甘えてくれる姿に癒されること間違いなし。
ペットは冒険に出かけ、様々なアイテムを持ち帰ってくれます。
さらに家具を自由に配置して個性的な空間を作れるほか、
レア家具の中にはステータスアップ効果を持つものもあります。

〓 フラワーコーデ 〓
可愛らしい洋服やアクセサリーを次々にアンロックし、自由にコーディネートできます。
メイクを変えて、自分だけのオリジナルスタイルを作り上げましょう。

※本物の花束イベントは常設・抽選となります。

data.name: Đạo Mộng Anh Hùng 2: Ảo Mộng
data.description_full:
Chào mừng bạn đến với Dreamland – vùng đất của những giấc mơ kỳ ảo! Bạn đã sẵn sàng cho một chuyến du ngoạn cực chill tại dị giới chưa?
Ơ! Sao mình lại biến thành Mộng Linh siêu cấp đáng yêu thế này?! Tại đây, bạn sẽ hóa thân thành một vị Anh Hùng (chính là Mộng Linh đó) bí ẩn, tự tay viết nên biên niên sử phiêu lưu cực chill trên vùng đất mới. Dựng trại nghỉ ngơi, phơi nắng, thưởng thức tiệc nướng BBQ cùng hội bạn, còn gì tuyệt vời hơn nhỉ?

[TREO MÁY NHÀN HẠ – TÀI NGUYÊN ĐẦY KHO]
Ngủ ngon một giấc, tỉnh dậy thấy... kho đồ nổ tung! Chỉ cần nằm khểnh trong chăn, tài nguyên vẫn về đầy túi. Lên cấp cực dễ, dùng chung cấp độ. Ai bảo nằm một chỗ là không thể thành trùm!

[TỔ ẤM DỊ GIỚI – SỐNG CHẬM CỰC CHILL]
Gom tài nguyên dị giới, tự tay xây đắp căn nhà trong mơ. Nhâm nhi ly nước, tận hưởng cuộc sống nhàn hạ đích thực giữa thế giới kỳ ảo!

[BẢN ĐỒ ĐA DẠNG – THÁM HIỂM VÔ TẬN]
Bạn thích đồng cỏ xanh ngát, nơi gió hát và hoa cỏ khẽ chạm làn da?
Hay khao khát đứng trước biển khơi, đón sóng vỗ và tận hưởng tự do?
Bạn muốn dấn thân vào những hầm ngục bí ẩn, khám phá Lõi Nham Thạch rực lửa hay Đảo Bay giữa tầng mây? Hãy tạm gác lại những lo toan, đến với Dreamland để nhìn ngắm thế giới muôn màu kỳ ảo ngay thôi!

[CẮM TRẠI GIAO LƯU – KẾT BẠN NHẸ NHÀNG]
Lửa trại bùng lên, hương thịt nướng thơm lừng tỏa khắp không gian. Trải tấm khăn, xếp những chiếc ghế nhỏ, hãy rủ ngay hội bạn thân cùng tụ tập thôi nào~ Cùng nếm thử xem nguyên liệu dị giới hấp dẫn đến thế nào nhé! Bạn có tò mò hương vị của Đuôi Rồng sẽ ra sao không?

[RẢNH TAY KHAI CHIẾN – ĐÁNH TRẬN CỰC ĐÃ]
Giải phóng đôi tay! Sẵn sàng chiến đấu mọi lúc mọi nơi! Chỉ cần một cái chạm nhẹ, đội hình của bạn sẽ ngay lập tức mang đến những màn trình diễn kỹ năng rực rỡ và mãn nhãn.

[THÚ CƯNG ĐA DẠNG – HỘI TỤ ĐÁNG YÊU]
Mộng Linh trình làng! Không chỉ xinh xắn, những người bạn này còn là trợ thủ đắc lực khi thám hiểm! Mỗi bé đều có tuyệt chiêu riêng: tăng tốc thu thập tài nguyên hoặc tung đòn cực mạnh khi ra trận! Đáng yêu thế này, ngại gì không nuôi ngay một đàn?

data.name: Tile Wonder Box
data.description_full:
How to Play：
Mode 1: Number Fusion Challenge
Tap numbers at the bottom to merge them onto different tracks. Here's the twist: same numbers on different tracks — but in the same row — can also merge! Plan wisely to prevent numbers from reaching the bottom. It's all about strategy and spatial thinking.

Mode 2: Arithmetic Battle
Drag plus/minus numbers from the far right and merge them with numbers in the center. Combine strategically to hit the target number. Each level is a living math puzzle that tests your calculation speed and path planning.

Mode 3: Color Linking Master
Find blocks with matching start and end colors, then connect them with your finger. Connect all blocks to clear the level. You'll need sharp observation and careful planning — one wrong connection can block your entire path.

✨ Why You'll Love It
🎯 Three unique modes, three fresh experiences – Numbers, arithmetic, and colors. Something for everyone.
🎨 Clean, vibrant visuals – Crisp design, bright colors, and satisfying sound effects.
🧠 Easy to learn, surprisingly deep – Simple rules, but mastering each mode takes real thought.
🔄 Endless replayability – Tons of levels with gradually increasing difficulty.
📦 Perfect for quick sessions – One-finger controls, great for short breaks.

🏆 Can you master all three modes?
From clever number merges to precise arithmetic and flawless color connections — three peaks await.

data.name: Game Is Hard
data.description_full:
Game is Hard is not your typical puzzle app. This is a pure brain puzzle experience designed for players who love being challenged. With its clever, minimalist style and unexpected interactions, it blends elements of brain games, logic, and device-based exploration into a collection of brutally tricky levels and hard puzzle challenges, creating a unique hard puzzle game experience.

Every puzzle breaks the rules, no flashy animations, no rewards for guessing. Just you, your mind, and a seemingly simple task that might hide a brilliant, almost impossible solution. Whether you’re into strategy, trivia games, or iq test challenges, Game is Hard invites you to test your patience, perception, and persistence in a truly engaging hard puzzle game.

This is not about fast reflexes. It’s about slow, methodical progress. Some levels require silence. Others need movement. Many seem unsolvable, until they’re not. It’s a place for deep thinking and bold experimentation. Hints are available when needed, but progress is always earned.

If you've enjoyed titles like brain test games, logic puzzles, IQ tests, moron test or brain teaser games, and if you love dissecting a good tricky quest, this game is for you. It rewards those who think differently, the curious, the clever, the quietly stubborn.

With full support for offline games, you can play wherever and whenever you want, perfect for no wifi games, no internet games, or long travel sessions. Whether you're on airplane mode or deep underground, all puzzles remain playable.

And yes, it’s hard. In fact, some say it's difficult, others call it impossible. But every puzzle is built with purpose and can be solved with logic. Each hard level is designed to challenge your thinking in a unique way. If you're a fan of brain training, mind games, or just enjoy testing your limits, you'll find yourself right at home.

Each level is full of hidden ideas and clever mechanics waiting to be discovered. You'll experiment with sound, light, rotation, and pressure, even waiting. Solutions are not always obvious. But when you find them, the satisfaction is incredible, making it a memorable hard puzzle game experience.

Designed for fans of both classic and modern puzzle games, Game is Hard avoids the noise of the typical mobile fun games and focuses instead on clarity, challenge, and meaningful interaction. There’s no time pressure. No ads. No noise. Just deep puzzles that respect your intelligence.
Whether you see yourself as a genius, an impulse problem-solver, or simply someone who enjoys a good brainly test, this game invites you to try. And try again. And maybe finally succeed.

Features:
• Handcrafted brain puzzle levels with clever, logical solutions
• Challenging hard puzzle mechanics and unique level design
• Hints are available, but never obvious
• Works fully offline, great for no wifi games and free play
• Minimalist, flat design with zero distractions
• Touch, motion, and sound-based mechanics
• Built for players who enjoy hard, clever, and unusual challenges
• No scores or timers, just pure gameplay

Aero Orbit X is an independent space flight simulation game designed for sci-fi exploration enthusiasts and masters of tactical timing. Observe the flight trajectory, monitor your altitude ascent, and take decisive action before the deep-space signal is lost.

✈️ Pure Exploration
This is a 100% offline experience. Aero Orbit X provides a highly responsive simulated environment that allows you to master flight patterns and challenge your altitude limits. All mission progress and virtual data are stored securely and exclusively on your local device.

🚀 Core Features:

Sleek Deep-Blue Interface: High-contrast, neon-blue visual effects designed to deliver a crystal-clear and professional deep-space flight dashboard experience.

Professional Flight Engine: Our advanced simulation engine generates unpredictable flight paths and random signal loss events for endless replayability.

Offline Access: No internet connection required. Launch your missions and explore the unknown orbit anytime, anywhere.

Virtual Gameplay: Designed for pure entertainment. All in-game resources (such as Cargo and Cells) and telemetry data hold no external or real-world value.

🎮 How to Play:

Load your virtual cargo, prime the engines, and tap to launch your aircraft.

Keep a close eye on the Altitude meter as your craft ascends higher into the orbit.

Tap the "Secure Data" button to safely recover your flight data and cells before the connection unexpectedly drops.

⚠️ Important Notice (Please Read):

This application is intended strictly for entertainment purposes only and is designed for adults aged 18 and older.

Aero Orbit X is a pure simulator. It does NOT offer any real-money rewards, real-world prizes, or cash value of any kind.

Practice or success within this virtual flight simulator does not imply or guarantee future success in real-world aviation or any other activities.
data.description_short: An offline deep-space flight simulator. Monitor altitude, and explore the orbit!

data.name: 키캡 - KeyCap
data.description_full:
키캡은 가볍게 키캡을 누르며 우리 학교의 누적 탭 수를 올리는 캐주얼 클리커 게임입니다.

탭 한 번이 내 기록이 되고, 우리 학교의 기록이 됩니다.
전국 초·중·고 학교 데이터를 기준으로 우리 학교가 전국, 시·도, 시·군 단위에서 어느 위치에 있는지 확인할 수 있습니다.

주요 기능

키캡 탭 카운터
화면의 키캡을 누르며 개인 누적 탭 수를 기록할 수 있습니다.

학교 단위 랭킹
내가 등록한 학교의 누적 탭 수가 학교 기록에 반영됩니다.
전국 랭킹, 지역 랭킹, 학교별 순위를 확인할 수 있습니다.

명예의 전당
누적 탭 기록이 높은 상위 기록을 확인할 수 있습니다.
꾸준히 탭하며 더 높은 기록에 도전해 보세요.

키캡 커스터마이즈
키캡 색상, 라벨, 스킨을 직접 꾸밀 수 있습니다.
위면과 앞면을 16×16 픽셀 아트로 꾸미며 나만의 키캡을 만들 수 있습니다.

칭호 시스템
탭 수가 쌓일수록 칭호가 성장합니다.
키캡 새내기부터 키캡 레전더리까지 단계별 목표를 달성해 보세요.

개인정보 안내

키캡은 이름, 전화번호, 주소와 같은 개인 식별 정보를 요구하지 않습니다.
학교 랭킹은 학교 단위의 누적 기록을 중심으로 제공되며, 사용자는 가볍게 게임을 즐길 수 있습니다.

광고 안내

앱에는 광고가 포함될 수 있습니다.
광고는 일정 사용 이후 노출될 수 있으며, 앱 내 구매를 통해 광고를 제거할 수 있습니다.

키캡은 단순한 탭 게임이지만, 우리 학교와 함께 기록을 쌓아가는 작은 경쟁의 재미를 제공합니다.
지금 키캡을 누르고 우리 학교 순위를 올려보세요.

data.name: Button Flow
data.description_full:
🧵 Button Flow – Relaxing Puzzle & Button Art
Step into a cozy world of colorful buttons where every move feels smooth and satisfying. Button Flow is a relaxing puzzle game where you match buttons with their correct color spots and uncover stunning artwork piece by piece.

🎮 How to Play
- Pick and Place Buttons: Each button belongs to a matching color spot. Tap to move and place them correctly to start building the design.
- Move in Groups: Buttons of the same color that are connected can move together, allowing you to place multiple pieces in a single action when space is available.
- Manage Your Waiting Space: Use the waiting tray to temporarily hold buttons when you’re not ready to place them. Keep things organized and plan your moves more efficiently.
- Build the Artwork: Every correct placement helps complete the hidden design. Piece by piece, the full picture gradually appears as you progress.

✨ Game Features
🧩 Relaxing Coloring Puzzle - Enjoy a blend of puzzle and coloring gameplay that’s easy to start but keeps your mind engaged. No pressure—just a calm and rewarding experience.
🎨 Discover Button Art - Watch each design slowly come to life as you place the right buttons. Every level is a small coloring journey, transforming scattered pieces into a complete artwork.
🌊 Smooth & Satisfying Flow - Clean visuals, smooth animations, and responsive effects make every button placement feel satisfying and precise.
💡 Designed for Everyone - Simple mechanics make it accessible for casual players, while thoughtful level design keeps puzzle lovers engaged.
🎯 Endless Levels to Explore - Explore a wide variety of button-based puzzles, from simple patterns to more detailed artistic layouts, with fresh content added regularly.

Button Flow blends engaging puzzle gameplay with a creative pixel art experience, letting you explore a peaceful world of color where every move reveals something new. With simple mechanics that gently challenge your focus and logic, it’s an experience that’s easy to enjoy for players of all ages.

🚀 Step into a peaceful world of color and creativity, and begin your artistic adventure in Button Flow today!

data.name: Monster Tactical Echo

◆ Relax & Play at Your Own Pace

No pressure, no rush. Play for five minutes or five hours—the game adapts to you. Perfect for commuters, busy professionals, and anyone who loves monster-collecting but hates grinding.

data.name: Zihin Üssü

Zihin Üssü, tek uygulamada 8 farklı Türkçe zeka oyununu bir araya getiren ücretsiz bir bulmaca koleksiyonudur. İnternet bağlantısı gerekmez, üyelik istemez, reklamlar dışında hiçbir engel yoktur. Türkçe kelime havuzu, yerel kültüre özgü modlar ve sade tasarımıyla her yaş için uygundur.

⚔️ Düello — Davet kodu paylaş, arkadaşınla kafa kafaya yarış. Aynı bulmacayı kim daha hızlı çözer?

- Sade, modern Türkçe arayüz

- Karanlık tema desteği

data.name: Tower Rush
data.description_full:
Aim for the clouds and test your architectural precision in Tower Rush, the ultimate arcade stacking challenge. Set against a beautiful urban skyline, your mission is to construct a magnificent skyscraper by carefully balancing unique home modules on top of one another. Each level brings a new beautifully designed floor, from cozy cottage-style rooms to elegant modern apartments, all swinging from a heavy-duty crane above your foundation. The gameplay is a pure test of rhythm and focus that rewards a steady hand. As you successfully attach more homes to your rising tower, the momentum of the swinging crane becomes more challenging to predict, turning every new floor into a high-stakes balancing act. The goal is to see just how many floors you can stack before the laws of physics take over, pushing your previous high scores to new limits with every attempt.

Tower Rush features a vibrant and detailed art style that makes every building look like a handcrafted masterpiece. The intuitive one-button controls make it easy for anyone to pick up and play, while the increasing speed and shifting weight of the blocks provide a deep challenge for masters of the genre. Monitor your score in real-time, keep an eye on your personal best, and strive to create the most impressive residential tower the city has ever seen. It is time to start building, find your rhythm, and show the world that you have what it takes to reach the top.

data.name: Jungle Mahjong: Match Tile

🌿 Welcome to the mysterious and vibrant Jungle Mahjong – a casual game that perfectly blends classic mahjong matching game play with the exotic vibes of a primeval rain forest. Tap to Match & Clear 🖱️: All tiles are face up. Simply tap two identical mahjong tiles in a row to clear them from the board. Clear the entire board to pass the level. Think carefully and plan your moves step by step!

Increasing Challenges 📈: As you advance, tile arrangements become more complex – multi-layer stacks, circular layouts, and more will test your observation and elimination order strategy.

Power-ups to Help 🧭: Stuck on a level? Use jungle-themed power-ups like "Shuffle," "Hint," or "Undo" to keep going.

💸 Play & Earn
A real money-making game has arrived! 💰
You earn cash rewards for every level you clear! No complicated steps, no recharge required – truly realize the dream of "playing games to earn money." As levels get harder, the rewards become even more generous! 🎉

💳 Withdrawal Methods
We support multiple convenient payment methods to transfer your earnings to your account.
Every time you successfully clear a level, the system automatically credits your cash reward! The more levels you pass, the more you earn. Rewards are available in real-time – withdraw anytime you like! 💵✨

🏆 Game Modes

🎲 Rich Levels – Hundreds of uniquely shaped boards and endless levels keep the game fresh and exciting!

🎯 Simple Rules – Tap or drag matching mahjong tiles to eliminate them; clear all tiles to win!

😌 Relaxing Experience – No penalties or time limits – just focus on matching tiles at your own pace.

🧠 Brain Training – Improve your focus and logical thinking while having fun!

🍃🀄️ Download Jungle Mahjong now and start your rain forest elimination journey – let every matching pair of tiles become the key to unlocking the jungle's blessings! 🌟

data.name: Arrow Pro 3D
data.description_full:
Welcome to Arrow Pro 3D, a relaxing and engaging 3D puzzle experience where observation, timing, and planning come together.
Rotate the cube, release arrows, and clear surfaces gradually. Careful observation and thoughtful decisions help create smooth clearing sequences and solve spatial challenges that gradually become more complex.
The controls are simple to understand, while puzzle layouts continue to encourage deeper thinking as progress continues.

- A fully rotatable 3D puzzle environment
Arrow Pro 3D takes place on an interactive three-dimensional cube. Unlike flat puzzle designs, every face contributes to the overall solution. At times, the answer may be located on the opposite side, requiring rotation and observation from different angles.
Players can rotate the cube freely, zoom in to inspect details, and study each surface before choosing the next move. This freedom allows exploration and supports thoughtful planning throughout each level.

- Release arrows and clear surfaces
The core mechanic focuses on releasing arrows in the correct order. Tap an arrow to activate it, and they will travel forward along its direction, removing other arrows encountered along the path.
Some arrows travel short distances, while others move across larger areas. Understanding how arrows interact allows multiple elements to be removed efficiently. Careful sequencing often creates satisfying chain reactions that clear large sections of the cube.

- Hundreds of handcrafted puzzles
Arrow Pro 3D contains a wide collection of handcrafted puzzles designed to maintain interest over time. Early challenges introduce fundamental behavior and basic movement patterns. As progress continues, layouts expand and require stronger observation and structured planning.
Players will encounter:
- Beginner-friendly compact cube layouts
- Medium difficulty spatial arrangements
- Large cube structures requiring careful reasoning
- Multi-stage solutions that reward planning and patience
Each layout presents a different arrangement that supports flexible thinking and encourages experimentation.

- Smooth and relaxing interactions
The overall experience focuses on steady pacing and visual clarity. Arrows glide across cube surfaces in a fluid motion. As elements disappear gradually, the cube becomes less crowded, creating a consistent visual rhythm.
A minimalist visual approach keeps attention on puzzle solving while maintaining readability during longer play sessions. Subtle animations provide visual feedback without distraction.

- Develop thinking skills naturally
Arrow Pro 3D offers a structured way to exercise reasoning skills while maintaining a calm environment.
Regular play supports:
- Spatial awareness
- Logical reasoning
- Planning ability
- Pattern recognition
- Problem-solving confidence
Players may spend time studying layouts carefully or proceed quickly through simpler puzzles. Each session supports observation and structured thinking.

- Designed for flexible play sessions
Whether there are only a few minutes available or a longer period of time, Arrow Pro 3D adapts comfortably to different schedules.Short puzzle layouts fit brief moments of play. Larger structures support longer sessions that encourage focused attention.
Suitable moments to play include:
- During short breaks
- While traveling
- Before rest
- During quiet moments
The structure supports gradual progression while maintaining a balanced level of challenge. Early puzzles provide clear learning opportunities, while later layouts require deeper reasoning and patience. Completing a puzzle often feels similar to solving a small mechanical structure.

FROM TABLETOP TO TOUCHSCREEN

data.name: Daedalus Labyrinth
data.description_full:
🏛️ ESCAPE THE LEGENDARY LABYRINTH

Enter the world of Daedalus, the master architect of Greek mythology. Navigate through infinite, procedurally generated labyrinths - no two mazes are ever the same!

🔦 EXPLORE THE UNKNOWN

The labyrinth doesn't reveal itself. Discover it step by step through darkness. Collect Spare Parts and Lines of Code to assemble essential tools:

- Labyrinth Charter (LC) - Keeps explored corridors lit
- Motion Sensor (MS) - Track Minotaur and Talos movements
- Traps Sensor (TS) - Reveal hidden traps
- Extension Sensor (ES) - Locate helpful items
- Beacon Activator (BA) - Mark the path to the exit

Princess Ariadne has hidden some Map Parts throughout the labyrinth - collect them to reveal large sections of the maze!

⚔️ ARM YOURSELF

Princess Ariadne has also hidden weapons to aid your escape:

- Walls Amplifier (WA) - Protective shield against the Minotaur
- Spear Pulse (SP) - Immobilize enemies temporarily

Collect batteries and magazines to power your weapons!

🎯 COMPLETE YOUR MISSION

Escaping isn't simple. You must:
1. Avoid the Minotaur (or multiple on harder levels!)
2. Find the switch to activate Talos
3. Chase Talos to retrieve the exit key
4. Reach the exit with the key

Beware of King Minos's traps: Data Loss, Display Malfunction, Labyrinth Reconstruction, Position traps, and Wall Raisers!

⚔️ THREE SOLO GAME MODES

- Cartographer - Map the labyrinth as you explore. Full challenge with tools, weapons, traps, and enemies.

- Explorer - Similar challenge, different starting conditions. Test your skills!

- Customizer - Create your perfect experience:
- Maze size from 9x9 to 31x31
- 4 lighting modes (total darkness to fully lit)
- Optional countdown timer
- Pure maze solving - no enemies or traps

🎮 BLUETOOTH BATTLES (Premium)

Challenge a friend nearby via Bluetooth! No internet required.

- First to Escape - Race through identical labyrinths. First player to exit wins!

- Minotaur Hunts - One player controls the hero, the other IS the Minotaur. Hunt or be hunted!

- Quantum Stream - Cooperative mode! Both players share the same labyrinth. Items collected by one player help both. But beware - traps affect both too! Work together to escape with the key!

🏆 FEATURES

- Infinite procedurally generated labyrinths
- Memory training - remember paths in darkness
- Multiple players per device with separate statistics
- Local achievements & leaderboards - works offline!
- Optional Google Play Games for global rankings
- Save anytime locally + cloud autosaves
- Premium themes to customize your labyrinth

🎨 CUSTOMIZE YOUR EXPERIENCE

Unlock premium themes to change the look of your labyrinth - walls, floors, and character figures including the fearsome Minotaur and mighty Talos!

📱 PLAY ON ANY DEVICE

- Phone and tablet optimized
- Google Play Games on PC supported
- Keyboard controls for PC gameplay

🧠 EXERCISE YOUR MIND

Navigate through darkness, remember your paths, plan your strategy. A fun way to challenge your memory and spatial thinking!

🏛️ Can you escape the labyrinth of Daedalus?

data.description_full:
Настоящая версия приложения представлена и функционирует в соответствии с требованиями законодательства Российской Федерации в отношении распространяемого в ней контента, в том числе не содержит пропаганды нетрадиционных сексуальных отношений, смены пола и иных материалов, распространение которых ограничено или запрещено законодательством Российской Федерации.

Клуб Романтики - это коллекция романтических историй, в которых вы можете делать выборы, тем самым влияя на сюжет.

Мечтали ли вы стать главным героем в своей любимой истории? В этой игре вы можете...
✦ Выбрать то как хотите выглядеть
✦ Влюбляться и идти на свидание с парнями или девушками
✦ Развивать отношения с другими персонажами и выбирать кем они станут - друзьями или врагами?
✦ Делать выборы которые изменят вашу судьбу
✦ Погружаться в разные миры - любовь, приключение и драма в одной игре!

Какую историю вы выберите в первую очередь?

❖ ДРАКУЛА: ИСТОРИЯ ЛЮБВИ - Водоворот придворных тайн Османской империи, любовь и ненависть наследных принцев, а ещё — друзья и враги, чей возраст — вечность...

❖ СЕКРЕТ НЕБЕС - "Я умерла и попала в школу ангелов и демонов. Адские лекции, ангельские парни, и соблазн нарушить небесные правила — что еще ждёт в этом фантастическом, но опасном мире?"

❖ ЛЕГЕНДА ИВЫ - Девушка готовится стать гейшей, но превращается в кицунэ — лисицу-оборотня. Теперь её преследуют... не только люди.

❖ ЛЮБОВЬ СО ЗВЕЗД - Принц с далёкой звезды предан, и теперь планета Земля должна стать ему новым домом. На помощь ему приходит простая девушка, которая и сама немного чужая в новом для неё городе.

data.name: Piggy Escape
data.description_full:
🐷 Screw Rescue — Match Two, Set Piggy Free! 🐷

Poor little piggy is trapped behind metal plates. Each plate is held in place by two screws. Your mission? Remove every screw and let the pig run free!

Tap two screws of the same color, and they disappear together. Get the colors right, and the plates start falling apart. Get it wrong? Those screws stay stuck.

Under the plates, there are 5 storage slots. When you tap a screw, it moves down into an empty slot, waiting for its matching partner. But if all 5 slots fill up with mismatched screws… you’re stuck. You’ll need to plan carefully and clear pairs before the slots overflow.

🧠 Trickier Every Level

⏱️ Race to Save the Pig
No timer, but you can compete with friends — who can rescue the piggy the fastest?

data.name: Сhickеn Rоаd
data.description_full:
Сhickеn Rоаd is a fast and addictive arcade game built around timing, focus, and quick reactions.
A chicken drops eggs from above, and your task is to keep them in play for as long as possible.

Each egg falls downward, gaining speed over time. Tap at the right moment to bounce it back up, as if sending it back toward the chicken. One tap equals one bounce — miss the timing, and the egg breaks instantly.

As you continue, the challenge increases. The falling speed grows with every successful bounce, demanding sharper reflexes and better control. Occasionally, two eggs fall at once, pushing your coordination even further.

There is no finish line — the goal is to last as long as possible and set a new personal record.

Сhickеn Rоаd delivers simple one-touch gameplay with rising intensity, turning every second into a test of precision and concentration.

Lấy cảm hứng từ những câu chuyện quen thuộc, game tái hiện một thời loạn thế mới, nơi 7 thế lực cùng tranh hùng. Thành trì liên tục đổi chủ, chiến sự lan rộng, từng trận chiến dâng cao như sóng lớn. Giữa cục diện ấy, bạn sẽ là người viết nên cục diện mới của thời loạn.

Đây là món quà cực hời khi bạn đăng nhập vào game, nhận ngay 1000 lượt chiêu mộ để thỏa sức săn đón các thần tướng SSR+ 5 sao như Lưu Bị, Quách Gia, Tào Tháo cùng hàng loạt anh kiệt lừng danh khác. Mỗi lần triệu hồi đều mang đến cảm giác hồi hộp, mở ra cơ hội sở hữu đội hình trong mơ.

Mỗi tướng đảm nhiệm một vai trò riêng như chiến sĩ, pháp sư, hộ vệ, thích khách, xạ thủ hay hỗ trợ, tạo nên nghệ thuật điều binh khiển tướng đầy chiều sâu. Kết hợp cùng những chiêu thức mãn nhãn của từng thần tướng, người chơi có thể linh hoạt bày trận đối chiến, biến hóa không ngừng trong từng trận đấu.

4. Thất Phe Tranh Đấu – Chiêu Mộ Anh Tài
Trong Anh Kiệt 3Q, hệ thống kết duyên độc đáo cho phép bạn tự do sáng tạo đội hình với 7 thế lực Hổ, Long, Phụng, Lân, Quang, Ám và Thần, mang đến nhiều cách phối hợp khiến đối thủ khó lòng bắt bài. Không chỉ sở hữu kỹ năng mạnh mẽ, các tướng còn gây ấn tượng với tạo hình phong cách Nhật Bản fantasy cực kỳ bắt mắt, càng chơi càng cuốn.

5. Thần Thú Dũng Mãnh – Đồng Hành Trợ Chiến
Mỗi lần giao tranh, bạn có thể mang theo tối đa 4 thần thú đồng hành. Mỗi thần thú đều có bộ kỹ năng đặc thù riêng, hỗ trợ chiến đấu theo nhiều cách khác nhau. Đặc biệt, chúng còn có thể kết duyên với nhau để tạo nên sức mạnh vượt trội, giúp bạn chiếm ưu thế trên chiến trường.

6. Quân Đoàn Đồng Lòng – Hợp Sức Lập Công
Bên cạnh những tính năng hấp dẫn trên, hệ thống quân đoàn cũng là điểm mà nhiều người chơi mong chờ. Tại đây, bạn sẽ cùng đồng đội phối hợp chiến thuật, vận dụng mưu trí để vượt qua những trận PK tổ đội cực kỳ máu lửa, mang lại trải nghiệm kịch tính khiến người chơi khó rời mắt.

data.name: Pantheon: Yaratılış Alevi
data.description_full:
Pantheon: Yaratılış Alevi, epik bir fantastik dünyaya kapı aralayan bir MMORPG mobil oyunudur. Ana görevleri tamamlayın, lonca savaşlarında zafer kazanın ve güçlü bir takım kurun. İş birliği yaparak efsanevi ekipmanlar ve nadir eşyalar elde edin; savaş gücünüzü zirveye taşıyın. Bu macera yalnızca zafer değil, aynı zamanda takım ruhu ve pozitif bir oyun deneyimi de sunar.

Yolculuğunuz boyunca farklı güçlerden gelen Kıyamet Elçileri ile tanışacak, birlikte Işığın Sonsuz Şehri’ni savunacaksınız. Pantheon: Yaratılış Alevi’ne katılın, büyüleyici bir maceraya adım atın ve ışığı koruyan bir kahramana dönüşün!
İster keşif tutkunuzu takip edin, ister savaş meydanlarında öne çıkın, ister sosyal etkileşimlerden keyif alın — burada herkese göre bir macera var. Hemen katılın ve bu destansı yolculuğun parçası olun!

[OYUN ÖZELLİKLERİ]
1. Devasa Dünya, Özgür Keşif

Yüksek kaliteli grafiklerle hazırlanmış geniş bir fantastik dünyaya adım atın.
Uçsuz bucaksız ormanlar, gizemli harabeler, sarp dağlar ve derin okyanuslar sizi bekliyor. Etkileşimli sahneler ve gizli sürprizlerle dolu bu 3D dünyada özgürce keşif yapabilir, her köşede saklı kadim sırları ortaya çıkarabilirsiniz. Cesur Kıyamet Elçileri için keşfedilecek sayısız gizem bulunuyor!

2. Tanrıların İttifakı, Karanlığa Karşı Savaş

Karanlık güçler yükseliyor, iblis orduları dünyayı tehdit ediyor.
Diğer muhafızlarla güçlerinizi birleştirin ve zorlu düşmanlara karşı savaşın! Çok oyunculu aynı ekran savaşlar, sunucular arası büyük ölçekli çatışmalar ve akıcı savaş mekanikleri ile heyecan dolu bir deneyim sizi bekliyor.
Yüksek ganimet oranları sayesinde güçlü ekipmanları kolayca toplayın ve her savaşı görsel bir şölene dönüştürün.

3. Zengin Ödüller, Rahat Oynanış

Oyuna giriş yaptığınız anda çeşitli ödüller sizi bekliyor:
Her gün ücretsiz elmaslar, seçilebilir UR ruhlar ve efsanevi Kraliçe Tifa! Otomatik görev sistemi sayesinde günlük görevleri kolayca tamamlayabilir, oyunun keyfini zahmetsizce çıkarabilirsiniz. Özel olarak tasarlanmış sistemler sayesinde gereksiz yüklerden kurtulun ve eğlenceye odaklanın.

4. Çoklu Sınıflar, Esnek Strateji

Zengin ırk çeşitliliği ve çok katmanlı sınıf sistemi ile kendi oyun tarzınızı oluşturun.
Her sınıfın kendine özgü yetenekleri ve savaş tarzı bulunur. İstediğiniz gibi takım kurun, stratejinizi belirleyin ve farklı savaş senaryolarında üstünlük sağlayın. Sınıflar arasında esnek geçiş yaparak her duruma uyum sağlayın ve epik savaşlara katılın!

data.name: Marble Group - Color Sort
data.description_full:
Think you can beat the conveyor? Step into Marble Group, a stunning 3D puzzle game where realistic physics meet fast color-matching logic. Your goal: sort rolling marbles from the top trays into the matching color boxes below. Easy to pick up, but hard to put down!

🎮 How It Works
Tap & Watch – Tap any top tray to release a marble. It falls with smooth, lifelike physics onto a rotating conveyor belt.
Follow the Flow – The belt never stops. You must decide the perfect moment to drop each marble.
Match & Clear – At the bottom, boxes wait for 3 marbles of the same color. Fill a box, and it disappears – making room for more.
Don’t Get Jammed – If the conveyor belt fills up and no matching box is available, it’s game over. Plan each move carefully!

✨ Why You’ll Love It
Clever Level Design – Puzzles grow more tricky and rewarding as you advance.
ASMR Satisfaction – Hear the gentle clink of rolling marbles and feel the stress melt away.
One Tap, Deep Strategy – Instant controls, endless brain training. Play anywhere, anytime.

Can you master the moving belt and sort every marble?
Download Marble Group now – and prove your puzzle skills!

data.name: Word Solitaire Go
data.description_full:
Word Solitaire Go is a refined word puzzle that blends the familiar structure of classic solitaire with the challenge of organizing meaning. Instead of numbers and suits, you work with complete word cards and group cards, turning a scattered table into a clear solution through thoughtful play.

How to Play
Every level begins with a partially revealed layout. You first establish the foundation by placing group cards, then draw new word cards into play and commit them to the right sets. Each placement shapes the board, opening some possibilities while quietly limiting others.
With a limited number of moves available, timing matters as much as correctness.

Strategy Over Speed
The challenge in Word Solitaire Go doesn’t come from fast reactions or memorization. It comes from judgment. Should you place a word now, or wait for more information? Should you draw another card, or stabilize what’s already on the table?
One decision can determine how the rest of the round unfolds.

Key Features
Solitaire-inspired gameplay using word and group cards
Meaning-based sorting that rewards logic and insight
A move-limited structure where every placement matters
Gradually evolving difficulty without sudden spikes
Clean, focused presentation designed for calm play

Designed for Thoughtful Players
Each session feels complete on its own, offering a clear beginning, rising tension, and a satisfying resolution. Over time, patterns become clearer, decisions sharper, and progress more rewarding.

Word Solitaire Go is calm on the surface, but deeply engaging once you lean in. It’s a game for players who enjoy focus, structure, and the quiet satisfaction of making everything fit.

data.name: Merge the Pips
data.description_full:
Core Game Rules
1. Connection Rules: You can slide to connect at least 3 adjacent dice with the same dot value vertically, horizontally or diagonally. Connections with fewer than 3 dice cannot trigger the merge effect.
2. Merge Rules: All connected dice of the same value will be eliminated and merged into one new dice with a dot value +1. (Example: Three 1-point dice merge into one 2-point dice; three 4-point dice merge into one 5-point dice.)
3. Scoring Rules: You will earn corresponding points for every successful connection and merge. More dice connected in a single move reward higher scores, and continuous merges help you accumulate more points.
4. Game Over Rules: The game ends in failure when the board is full of dice and there are no available matching dice connections. The final score will be settled at the end of the game.

**No Fight: Slice the Ice, Stop Animal Brawls**

Animals on floating ice are starting to fight! When different species are crowded together, they attack each other. If any animal falls into the water, you lose. Use your strategy to slice the ice and completely separate them—only when all animals stop fighting can you clear the level.

**Dynamic Ice Layouts**
Each level features 1 to 3 ice floes with unique shapes and positions. Narrow strips, L-shapes, scattered fragments… the same number of cuts creates entirely different spatial challenges.

**Limited Cuts, Maximum Strategy**
You only get a fixed number of slicing lines per level. Use the fewest cuts to achieve total separation and prove your puzzle-solving skills. Simple rules, but cleverly designed challenges that test your observation and planning.

**Play Anytime, Anywhere**
No complicated controls or lengthy storylines. Open the game anytime—on your commute or while waiting in line. Easy to pick up, relaxing to play, and simple to put down.

**Earn Coins, Get Rewards**
Complete mediation bonuses and daily tasks to earn coins. Save enough and withdraw to your personal account—enjoy a little extra reward while having fun!
data.description_short: Stop the fight, earn rewards right.

data.name: TS Origin - VTC
data.description_full:
Quyết định phê duyệt nội dung kịch bản trò chơi điện tử G1 trên mạng số: 209/QĐ-PTTH&TTĐT do Cục Phát thanh, truyền hình và thông tin điện tử cấp ngày 24/04/2026
https://giayphep.abei.gov.vn/g1/132000

Quay lại chiến trường turn-based kinh điển: Bước vào thế giới Tam Quốc diệu kỳ, nơi những trận đánh không chỉ là sức mạnh mà là cuộc đấu trí đỉnh cao. TS Origin tái hiện nguyên vẹn linh hồn của dòng game turn-based huyền thoại, nơi bạn làm chủ từng lượt đánh, định đoạt giang sơn chỉ bằng một cú chạm. Đồ họa nguyên bản, lối chơi kinh điển – Đã đến lúc viết tiếp chương mới cho thanh xuân của chính mình!

1. Tự do thu phục, mở lối chơi riêng
Đừng chỉ nhìn, hãy sở hữu! Tại TS Origin, từ danh tướng lẫy lừng như Lữ Bố, Gia Cát Lượng đến những NPC ven đường, tất cả đều có thể trở thành ""đệ tử"" trung thành dưới trướng bạn. Tự do bắt tướng, thiết lập đội hình độc bản không đụng hàng. Bạn muốn một đội hình toàn ""Ba Đậu Yêu"" hay dàn mỹ nhân điêu đứng thiên hạ? Tất cả nằm ở nhân phẩm và kỹ năng thu phục của bạn!

2. Tứ hệ xoay chuyển, lật kèo ngoạn mục
Không có kẻ mạnh nhất, chỉ có kẻ tính toán giỏi nhất! Với hệ thống tứ hệ Địa – Thủy – Hỏa – Phong khắc chế nghiêm ngặt, mỗi trận đấu là một bàn cờ cân não. Chỉ cần một bước đi đúng, một kỹ năng khống chế chuẩn xác, bạn hoàn toàn có thể lật ngược thế cờ dù đối thủ có mạnh đến đâu. Đẳng cấp chiến thuật thực thụ là đây!

3. Cam kết đông vui, cùng nhau vượt ải.
Mệt mỏi vì server "vắng như chùa bà Đanh"? TS Origin cam kết một thế giới nhộn nhịp, nơi dòng người tấp nập tại Trác Quận không bao giờ dứt. Cùng anh em lập đội vượt ải, săn Boss vạn người, hay đơn giản là ngồi đàm đạo giữa thành. Game là phải có anh em – VTC cam kết bến đỗ ổn định, cộng đồng bền vững, nói không với việc "chơi một mình với NPC"!

4. Vượt đài Khổng Tước - Giải cứu Nhị Kiều
Ải mỹ nhân luôn là thử thách khó nhất! Hãy chuẩn bị đội hình mạnh nhất để tiến đánh Khổng Tước Đài, vượt qua hàng chục tầng tháp canh nghiêm ngặt để giải cứu Đại Kiều, Tiểu Kiều. Không chỉ là nhiệm vụ, đây là nơi khẳng định vị thế anh hùng và thu về những phần thưởng cực phẩm mà bất cứ ai cũng khao khát.

5. Quay lại Trác Quận – tụ họp chiến hữu.
"Hẹn gặp ở Trác Quận" – câu nói quen thuộc của 20 năm trước giờ đây đã trở lại. Những rừng đào rực rỡ, những cây cầu gỗ thân thương đang chờ đón bước chân bạn. Hãy cùng những chiến hữu năm xưa tụ họp, ôn lại kỷ niệm và cùng nhau chinh phạt những vùng đất mới. TS Origin – Nơi tình bạn cũ bắt đầu cuộc hành trình mới.

6. Update chính chủ Chinese Gamer
An tâm tuyệt đối với phiên bản cập nhật chính chủ từ nhà phát triển gốc Chinese Gamer. Mọi tính năng, sự kiện và lộ trình phát triển đều được đảm bảo dài hạn và chuyên nghiệp. Không còn nỗi lo bản lậu, không sợ nạp rồi sập – TS Origin là sự đầu tư xứng đáng cho niềm đam mê của bạn.

- Drag and drop: Drag a card to move it anywhere.
- Find the Links: Group pictures that share the same trait, category, or visual connection.
- Complete a Row: Collect matching picture cards into one full row to finish the set.
- Clear the Board: Complete all required rows to beat the level and move on.

- World Leaderboard: Build your total score and see how high you can climb.

✨ Why You’ll Love Card Match Up:
- Easy to Learn, Satisfying to Master: Simple controls make it accessible, while later levels offer real puzzle depth.
- Fun Visual Logic: Match cards by shared themes, professions, styles, animals, and more.
- Rewarding Collection Gameplay: Completing each row feels neat, clear, and satisfying.
- Perfect for Quick Play Sessions: Jump in anytime for a few rounds or a longer challenge.
- Competitive Progression: Every win helps improve your score, rank, and standing.
🎮 Features:

- Hundreds of Clever Levels: Enjoy varied themes and increasing challenge as you progress.
- Leaderboard Competition: Compete in weekly rankings, build your total score, and chase top positions.
- Smooth Mobile Experience: Fast, intuitive controls designed for satisfying play on the go.
If you enjoy sorting puzzles, matching games, collection mechanics, and light competition, Card Match Up is the perfect game to pick up and play. It’s simple, clever, rewarding, and hard to put down.
Ready to complete every row and climb the rankings? Download Card Match Up now and start collecting!

data.name: Тоwer Rush
data.description_full:
Тоwer Rush is a timing-based building challenge where precision and rhythm determine how long your structure can stay stable. The tower is never completely still—it subtly “breathes,” shifting and moving as you prepare each placement. Your goal is to drop every falling block at the exact moment the structure is aligned, maintaining balance and preventing collapse.

The core gameplay is about syncing your actions with the tower’s movement pattern. You need to observe its rhythm, understand its flow, and release each block at the right phase. A mistimed drop can disturb the structure and create instability that makes further placement more difficult.

As the pace increases, the movement becomes faster and less predictable, reducing your timing window. Every successful drop requires sharper focus, better anticipation, and precise control. Each round becomes a continuous test of coordination, where staying in rhythm is the only way forward.
data.description_short: Time your drops and keep the breathing tower stable

data.name: Arrow Snake Blast
data.description_full:
Arrow Snake Blast: Pure Logic. Pure Satisfaction. 🧩

Untangle your mind with the ultimate spatial logic challenge! Arrow Snake Blast combines minimalist design with brain-teasing puzzles. Can you find the perfect sequence to clear the path?

🎮 HOW TO PLAY

Check the Direction: Every arrow (or snake) moves only where its head points.

Tap to Slide: If the path is clear, it glides out. If blocked, it stays put.

Master the Sequence: One wrong move can create a deadlock. Plan ahead to clear the board!

Clear the Maze: Get every element to the exit to conquer the level.

✨ KEY FEATURES

🔄 Unique Skin Swap: Start with the sleek Classic Arrow look. Want a change? Unlock and switch to the Vibrant Snake skin anytime to refresh your experience!

🧠 Hundreds of Clever Levels: From relaxing starters to mind-bending expert mazes.

🧘 Stress-Free Logic: No timers, no high-pressure countdowns. Think at your own pace and enjoy the "Zen" of solving.

✨ Satisfying Visuals: Experience the smooth, fluid "Blast" as each piece slides perfectly out of the grid.

🌟 WHY YOU’LL LOVE IT

Two Vibes, One Game: Swap freely between Arrows and Snakes to suit your mood.

Daily Brain Training: Keep your mind sharp with fresh challenges every day.

Pure Puzzle Joy: No distractions—just you and the satisfaction of a perfect solution.

Ready to untangle the challenge? Download Arrow Snake Blast for FREE and start sliding!

Amber Quill keeps the round balanced, Peach Zephyr lifts every payout, Hayfield Crest enlarges every daily harvest, Sunset Ember rewards long flights above three times the wager, and Horizon Halo combines an extra payout with a richer daily grain claim. data.name: Arrow Rush 3D
data.description_full:
Imagine a 3D cube covered in arrows. Some point straight ahead. Others twist around corners — stretching across two or even three faces. Your job? Tap each arrow in the right direction to make it fly off the cube. Sounds simple? Wait until they start crossing paths.

🎯 How It Works
Every arrow has a direction — up, down, left, right, or a bendy path that wraps around the cube. You need to tap an arrow so it follows its direction and leaves the cube cleanly. But here’s the catch: arrows must not crash into each other. A wrong tap could send two arrows straight into a collision!

🔄 Inspect Every Angle
The cube is fully rotatable. Drag to spin it, zoom in to see the tricky corners, and study how arrows connect across faces. Some arrows hide their tails on the other side. Only by looking from every angle can you figure out the right order.

🧠 Plan Your Taps
It’s not just about tapping fast. You have to think ahead — which arrow should go first? Which one will block another if you tap too early? The arrows are interlocked like a puzzle knot. Solve the sequence and watch them all fly away.

🧩 More Than Just a Cube
As you progress, the arrows get crazier — longer paths, tighter turns, and more overlapping routes. Each level is a new brain‑teaser that makes you twist your thinking along with the cube.

Ready to twist, tap, and untangle? Grab the cube and let the arrows find their way home! 🔄➡️⬆️⬇️🔲
