data.name: Elite Commando: Secret Mission
data.description_full:
Step into the role of an elite soldier in a high-stakes military action game where every mission brings you closer to stopping a powerful enemy network. The story unfolds across five intense levels filled with dramatic attacks, strategic battles, and dangerous missions. As chaos spreads and the enemy launches surprise assaults, you must rise as the hero who fights back, protects key leaders, and destroys the forces threatening national security.
The story begins with a secret strategic meeting where the Prime Minister sits together with trusted generals and military advisors. Inside a confidential meeting room, maps of enemy territories and tactical plans cover the table as they discuss their next move against a dangerous enemy organization. The discussion is serious and tense, as the leaders know the future of the country may depend on their decisions. However, unknown to them, enemy spies have already discovered the location of the meeting. Moments later, a hostile drone silently approaches the building. Without warning, it launches a devastating missile strike. A massive explosion shakes the area, destroying the meeting location and leaving the military leadership under attack. This shocking incident becomes the starting point of a deadly conflict.
You play as a highly trained elite soldier, assigned to investigate the attack and eliminate the enemy forces responsible for it. Your mission begins with tracking down hostile soldiers hiding in nearby areas and taking them out before they can launch another strike. Every step forward uncovers more evidence of a larger enemy operation.
In the next phase of the conflict, the situation becomes even worse when a military cargo ship carrying critical weapons and equipment is targeted while traveling across the sea. Enemy radar systems detect the ship and launch a coordinated missile attack. The missiles hit their target with devastating accuracy, severely damaging the ship. Within moments, the vessel begins sinking beneath the ocean waves, taking valuable military resources with it. This loss becomes a turning point in the operation, forcing the military to retaliate. Your next mission is to infiltrate the enemy positions responsible for the attack and eliminate the soldiers behind the destruction.
The conflict escalates further when a major airbase comes under sudden attack. Fighter jets are landing and taking off while soldiers continue their normal duties, unaware of the danger approaching. Suddenly, enemy missiles rain down on the base. Explosions rip across the runway and hangars, destroying aircraft and causing chaos among the defending forces. As a special commando, you are deployed to strike back against the enemy camps responsible for the airbase assault. Precision combat and quick decision-making are the only ways to complete the mission and stop further destruction.

data.name: Sky Build
data.description_full:
Feel the thrill with Sky Build and test your reaction speed! 🏗️⚡ Your task is to fill all three slots with the same symbol before time runs out.

The slots with three symbols quickly and cyclically change icons 🔄 Tap on a slot to lock the current symbol and tapping again will unlock it, but it will cost you 2 seconds ⏳ Plan your actions carefully, because every second counts.

Once all three slots are locked, the result is checked 🎯 If the symbols match, you win! If not, the slots will automatically unlock, giving you a chance to try again. For the daring, there is a “build” button 🚀 that locks all slots at once — a risky but sometimes very profitable move.

When the time runs out, the symbols are fixed where they stopped ⏱️ If they are the same, you win; if they are different, the game is over. Each level has a different time limit and the first stages are a little easier to start with. Sky Build is all about speed, strategy and excitement in every round!

data.name: Twisted Paths
data.description_full:
Twisted Paths is a clever puzzle experience where every tap reveals a new path. Follow the arrows, unlock tangled routes, and clear the maze by choosing the right order. Each move matters — one wrong tap can block the path, while the right move creates a smooth and satisfying chain of motion.
Simple to start, yet challenging to master, Twisted Paths turns colorful arrow mazes into engaging logic puzzles.
Follow the Arrows
Each path has its own direction. Tap arrows in the correct sequence to send them out of the board and gradually open space for the remaining paths. Plan your moves carefully and watch the maze untangle step by step.
Untangle Twisted Mazes
Levels are filled with intertwined paths that twist around each other. Finding the right order to release them is the key to solving the puzzle.
Relaxing Yet Clever Gameplay
Twisted Paths combines satisfying motion with thoughtful puzzle design. It’s easy to learn, relaxing to play, and rewarding to solve.
Game Features
• Unique arrow-based maze puzzles
• Tap to clear paths and solve logic challenges
• Colorful and satisfying path animations
• Hundreds of handcrafted levels
• Increasing difficulty and clever layouts
• Simple controls with strategic gameplay
• Perfect for quick brain training sessions
If you enjoy logic puzzles, maze challenges, and satisfying tap mechanics, Twisted Paths offers a relaxing yet engaging puzzle journey.

Untangle the paths.
Solve the maze.

Puzzle pieces float in the air initially; players need to select and place them manually from the bottom to the correct position.

เหล่าผู้แข็งแกร่งจำนวนมากออกเรือเพื่อตามล่าฝัน เพียงเพื่อขึ้นครองบัลลังก์แห่งท้องทะเล

จัดวางตำแหน่งหน้า, การโจมตี และการควบคุมอย่างสมดุล เปิดใช้งานความสามารถเชื่อมโยงของทีม ระเบิดสกิลคอมโบสุดทรงพลัง และก้าวข้ามขีดจำกัดของการต่อสู้!

จาก อาลาบาสตา ไปยังซากเกาะท้องฟ้า จากคุกใต้ทะเล ถึงสงครามมารีนฟอร์ด ทุกการเดินทางเต็มไปด้วยความท้าทายและความมันส์

• สงครามทะเลข้ามเซิร์ฟเวอร์ ครองโลกใหม่
ต่อสู้กับผู้เล่นจากทั่วโลกเพื่อแย่งชิงทะเล ยึดเกาะทรัพยากร และชิงธงทะเล
มีเพียงผู้แข็งแกร่งจริงเท่านั้นที่จะได้รับเกียรติ “สี่จักรพรรดิใหม่”

• ระบบการเติบโตที่สมบูรณ์ ก้าวข้ามขีดจำกัด
ปลุกพลังแผนที่ดวงดาว เสริมทักษะเฉพาะตัว พัฒนาความสัมพันธ์ ฝึกฝนเพื่อนร่วมทีมหลักหลายมิติ
เส้นทางการเติบโตที่แตกต่างสร้างรูปแบบกลยุทธ์หลากหลาย ควบคุมทิศทางของการต่อสู้ได้อย่างเต็มที่

จากกัปตันหน้าใหม่ที่ยังไม่เป็นที่รู้จัก
สู่เจ้าแห่งท้องทะเลผู้สั่นสะเทือนโลกใหม่——
ท้องทะเลนี้ จะจารึกชื่อของคุณตลอดกาล

Stuck? Use the "Add Tube" power-up or the "Undo" button to find a new strategy!

data.name: Minicraft: Block Craft 3D
data.description_full:
Welcome to Minicraft: Block Craft 3D!

Minicraft: Block Craft 3D is a professional sandbox adventure game that allows players to explore a vast block-based world filled with creativity, survival challenges, and endless possibilities. It is designed for players who enjoy crafting, building, and discovering new environments.

1. Open World Exploration
The game features a large, procedurally generated open world where every area feels unique. Players can explore forests, mountains, caves, deserts, and oceans, making each journey exciting and unpredictable.

2. Creative Building System
With its flexible block-based building system, players can construct anything they imagine. From simple houses to massive cities and detailed structures, creativity has no limits.

3. Survival Mode Challenges
In Survival mode, players must collect resources, craft tools, and defend themselves against hostile creatures. The day and night cycle increases difficulty, as enemies become more dangerous after sunset.

4. Creative Mode Freedom
Creative mode provides unlimited resources and the ability to fly. This mode is perfect for players who want to focus entirely on building and design without survival restrictions.

5. Mining and Crafting Mechanics
Mining plays a central role in the game. Players gather ores and materials to craft tools, weapons, armor, and other useful items using an easy-to-learn crafting system.

6. Enchanting and Brewing Systems
As players progress, they can unlock enchanting and potion brewing features. These systems enhance tools and equipment with special abilities, improving survival and exploration.

7. Mobs and Creatures
The world is filled with a variety of mobs, each with unique behaviors and challenges. Players must adjust their strategies to survive encounters with different creatures.

8. Biomes and Special Dimensions
Multiple biomes offer diverse landscapes, climates, and resources. Special dimensions introduce rare items, tougher enemies, and exciting new adventures.

9. Redstone Engineering
The redstone system allows players to create automated machines, traps, and mechanisms. From basic switches to advanced circuits, it adds depth and creativity to gameplay.

10. Multiplayer Experience
Multiplayer mode enables players to connect, collaborate, or compete with others. Build together, explore new areas, or engage in PvP battles for a more social gaming experience.

In essence, Minicraft: Block Craft 3D stands out through its perfect balance of creative freedom, open-world exploration, and engaging survival challenges. Supported by an active and growing community, the game continues to evolve with new possibilities. Whether you choose to play alone or team up with friends, the blocky world offers endless opportunities for fun and imagination.

Right across the street sits the strangest house on the block… the home of Angry Neighbor 🏠🔍. Angry Neighbor is always grumpy, keeps every window boarded up, and paces around muttering to himself. Late at night you sometimes hear odd noises drifting over—strange thumps, muffled sounds, maybe even distant cries. What exactly is Angry Neighbor hiding in there? A forgotten treasure? Hide in closets, behind doors, or anywhere dark and quiet.

Bright, colorful 3D graphics make every room feel alive—cluttered living rooms, messy kitchens, shadowy basements full of surprises. Scattered everywhere are glowing mystery cubes ✨. Collect them all and you’ll unlock secret paths, bonus areas, and extra pieces of the story.

Deep in the basement waits the biggest puzzle of all: a thick brick wall you can actually smash through 🧱💥. What’s on the other side? Clues to why Angry Neighbor acts so strange, explanations for those nighttime noises, maybe even the real reason behind his permanent frown 😠. Some players discover hidden endings by finding every cube, reading every note, and staying one step ahead of Angry Neighbor the whole time.

Hello Angry Neighbor Stories Horror mixes perfect hide-and-seek tension with clever exploration and plenty of silly chase moments. No monsters, no jump scares—just the excitement of sneaking, the thrill of almost getting caught, and the satisfaction of slowly piecing together the mystery of the grumpiest neighbor around.

data.name: Fishing Freeze
data.description_full:
The lake is iced over, the air is still — and your next dive begins with a single tap. Press Cast, and the depth wheel chooses how far you’ll go, anywhere from 5m to 100m. The deeper it sends you, the more score points you can get.

Once you’re underwater, everything comes down to timing. Fish glide past your hook, and you need to tap at the exact moment a fish is close enough to set it. Get it right and “Hooked!” appears — now you have a catch to finish.

To bring the fish up, you face a fast 3-round swipe challenge. Each round shows a direction — swipe up, left, or right — and gives you 3 seconds to react. Clear all rounds without mistakes to catch the fish and claim your points. Swipe the wrong way or run out of time and you’ll see “Missed!” — no points, and you’re back on the shore ready to cast again.

Need a quick reminder? The Information screen keeps the rules short and clear. And Catch Guide works like a little depth notebook: each card shows a depth range, the points you can get there, and sample fish you might meet, so you always know what you’re aiming for before your next cast.

We guarantee: Solitaria will put your brain & your lexical skills to the test! 🧠 It’s a true breath of fresh air for experienced word puzzle players.

How to play Solitaria:

• scan the open cards and find words that can be combined into a semantic cluster;
• collect all related terms in one stack, starting with the golden category card;
• clear bottom cards to access those lying above — just like in classic solitaire;
• if there is nothing left to group on the board, draw cards from the deck and repeat the arranging process with new words and images;
• keep in mind that only terms and images with a common theme can be combined;
• try to save moves and empty card slots, cause if you run out of space, you'll get stuck;
• when there are no moves left or the attempt limit is reached, use hints or restart the level;
• if you manage to correctly link all associations and no cards remain on the field — congratulations, you’ve won!

data.name: Tile Hole Master
data.description_full:
Tile Hole Master is a structured tile puzzle where you control a moving hole to swallow tiles and clear the board. Each level presents a carefully arranged tile layout that requires precise movement, smart positioning, and strategic board clearing.
In Tile Hole Master, the goal is simple: move the hole across the board and collect all tiles. However, each tile puzzle introduces different formations, stacked tile clusters, compact tile grids, and layered tile layouts that change how you approach the board. You must plan your path to avoid blocking future movement while clearing every tile.
Core Tile Hole Gameplay
• Drag to move the hole freely across the board
• Swallow tiles by positioning the hole correctly
• Clear all tiles to complete the level
• Avoid bombs and blocked zones
• Use boosters to manage dense tile formations
• Progress through increasingly structured tile boards
The tile hole mechanic focuses on movement precision and spatial awareness. Because tiles are arranged in structured formations, clearing one area too quickly may limit access to other tile groups. Careful path planning becomes essential as tile layouts grow more complex.

Tile Puzzle Design
Tile Hole Master is built around tile collection and board clearing strategy. Each tile puzzle level introduces different board shapes and tile arrangements. Some boards feature compact tile stacks. Others include layered tile blocks that require gradual clearing.
The puzzle design emphasizes tile grouping and tile flow. Understanding how tiles connect and how the hole moves across the surface is key to solving each stage. Tile collect strategy becomes more important as levels increase in density and obstacle placement.

Themed Tile Collections
Throughout progression, the tile visuals evolve into themed tile worlds while maintaining the same tile hole mechanic. The themes change the appearance of the tiles but preserve the structured tile puzzle gameplay.
Each theme introduces a fresh tile environment while keeping the tile collect and board clear objective consistent. The themed tiles create visual variety without changing the core hole puzzle structure.

Mahjong-Style Tile Layouts
Some levels feature mahjong-style tile layouts, inspired by structured tile stacks and patterned tile formations. These mahjong-style tile boards focus on arrangement awareness and board clearing order.
While Tile Hole Master is not a traditional mahjong match game, the visual tile structures may resemble mahjong tile stacks. The gameplay remains centered on moving the hole, swallowing tiles, and clearing the board.
Obstacles and Boosters: As tile boards become denser, additional elements appear:
Boosters help manage complex tile formations by supporting tile clearing in crowded areas. Strategic use of boosters can assist in finishing structured tile layouts.

data.name: Yarnation: Unravel Flow
data.description_full:
Unravel the Threads. Complete the Pattern. Feel the Flow.

Yarnation: Unravel Flow is a relaxing yet deeply engaging sorting puzzle game where you unravel beautifully knitted artwork using colorful yarn bobbins. Instead of blasting or matching tiles, you carefully remove stitches in the correct order to clear each woven design piece by piece.

Every level feels like solving a handcrafted knitting puzzle.
Every move shapes the flow.
Every unravel delivers a satisfying visual payoff.

If you enjoy cozy puzzle games, color sorting challenges, flow puzzles, and calm strategy-based gameplay, Yarnation: Unravel Flow offers a smooth and rewarding experience that keeps your mind active while staying relaxing.

🧶 A UNIQUE YARN PUZZLE EXPERIENCE

Bobbins move along a conveyor system and collect stitches of their own color.
Each bobbin has a limited capacity that decreases as it gathers matching yarn stitches.

When a bobbin’s capacity reaches zero, it disappears.
If capacity remains, it returns to the rack, ready to be reused later.

This simple yet clever system creates a satisfying puzzle loop where:

• Color selection matters
• Order matters
• Planning matters
• Capacity management matters

Complete each knitted pattern by using the right bobbins in the right sequence.

🧠 STRATEGY OVER SPEED

Yarnation: Unravel Flow is not about frantic tapping.
It’s about smart decisions and smooth sequencing.

As you advance through the levels:

• Patterns become more layered and detailed
• Colors overlap and intertwine
• Rack space becomes limited
• Managing your moves becomes more important

You’ll need to analyze the layout carefully, think a few steps ahead, and maintain a clean unravel flow without blocking yourself.

It’s a logic puzzle at heart — calm, thoughtful, and deeply satisfying.

🎨 COZY KNITTED AESTHETIC

Immerse yourself in a warm and visually charming yarn world featuring:

• Soft knitted textures
• Handcrafted pixel-style artwork
• Clean and colorful stitch patterns
• Smooth unravel animations
• Clear visual feedback

Watching a detailed knitted image slowly unravel into completion creates a uniquely relaxing puzzle experience.

🔁 PROGRESSIVE PUZZLE DEPTH

With hundreds of handcrafted levels, Yarnation: Unravel Flow introduces new challenges throughout progression:

• Fresh stitch arrangements
• New color combinations
• Deeper sequencing logic
• Smarter rack usage

The difficulty curve remains smooth and accessible while offering enough depth to keep puzzle lovers engaged.

🎮 SIMPLE CONTROLS, DEEP GAMEPLAY

The one-tap control system keeps the experience intuitive and easy to learn.

But beneath that simplicity lies a strategy puzzle built around:

• Color sorting
• Flow management
• Capacity control
• Smart sequencing

Easy to start.
Satisfying to master.

READY TO UNRAVEL?

Pull the right thread.
Plan your sequence.
Complete every knitted pattern with precision.

Yarnation: Unravel Flow is a fresh take on sorting puzzles — calm, strategic, visually satisfying, and beautifully woven.

data.name: City Coach Bus 3D Bus Driving
data.description_full:
City Coach Bus 3D Bus Driving is an immersive bus simulator designed for players who enjoy realistic driving mechanics and modern city transport gameplay. Step into the role of a professional coach bus driver and take control of powerful buses as you complete structured passenger transport missions across detailed urban routes.

The game features 5 carefully designed levels, and each level begins with a short cinematic introduction that highlights mission objectives and the surrounding environment. Players start their journey with access to three different bus models, including modern city buses and coach buses, all featuring smooth handling, detailed interiors, and responsive controls for a true 3D bus driving experience.

Most of the gameplay takes place in a lively US-inspired city environment, complete with realistic roads, traffic systems, signals, and moving vehicles. As a city bus driver, your task is to pick up and drop off passengers safely, follow traffic rules, and complete routes efficiently to progress through the game. Each level gradually increases in difficulty, testing your driving precision, timing, and control while remaining enjoyable for players of all skill levels.

In addition to busy city routes, City Coach Bus 3D Bus Driving also offers scenic seaside roads that provide a relaxing change of pace and visual variety. These calm driving areas enhance immersion and make long drives more enjoyable. Some missions include light off-road sections, adding extra challenge and variety without compromising smooth gameplay.

Whether you prefer modern coach buses, realistic city traffic, or relaxing scenic routes, City Coach Bus 3D Bus Driving delivers a complete and engaging bus simulator experience for fans of realistic driving games.

data.name: Imposter Game: Who is the Spy?
data.description_full:
Listen closely and decide together - WHO IS THE IMPOSTER?

The Imposter game is built around one simple mechanic: most players know the secret word, and one does not. In every round of this imposter party word game, each person gives an association. One player must fake it and try to blend in.

The group talks, debates, and tries to find the impostor before it’s too late. Someone may confidently guess the imposter, while others wait and analyze who is the spy.


HOW TO PLAY
- See the word — or fake it if you didn’t.
- Give a clue.
- Discuss who is suspicious.
- Vote to find the impostor.

This imposter party word game is a hidden liar game, where subtle lying and careful listening decide the outcome. Players constantly try to find out who is lying, then they may challenge each other to explain their hints. When the discussion peaks, everyone will vote to guess the imposter.
In every imposter game, you must observe reactions and help the group find the impostor. Sometimes you immediately know who is the imposter; other times you hesitate, wondering who is lying while someone tries to fake it again!


Social deduction made simple: read people, think fast, and have fun!
Inspired by familiar unmask the spy game formats, this gameplay focuses on conversation and deduction—read behavior, control the situation and find who is the spy, or stay undercover and don't reveal yourself while guessing!

Listen carefully, analyze hints, and unmask the secret role. Each round challenges you to uncover the truth, even when someone stays completely under cover. Soon the room fills with questions: who imposter was acting strange? Who is lying about their clue? And finally — Who is the imposter?

PERFECT FOR GROUPS
It’s a simple game to play with friends! This flexible party game belongs in every collection of fun games to play with friends—it works as a quick group game during gatherings, trips or night parties. It fits naturally, it's easy to start, and matches other classic fun party games.
You can launch an imposter game anywhere and begin an imposter party word game session in seconds. Whether you’re hosting a casual party game night or organizing spontaneous fun games to play with friends, the format keeps everyone involved.

Play again and fake it better. Listen closer. And find the impostor! In every imposter game, someone must stay undercover, others will guess the imposter, and then must decide who is the spy.

data.name: Arrow Go - Logic Puzzle Game
data.description_full:
Dive into Arrow Go, the ultimate logic puzzle game designed to sharpen your brain and test your precision. Your goal is straightforward yet satisfying: tap away the arrows to clear the screen, but there is a catch—these arrows only fly in one direction. You must assess the board, plan your sequence, and ensure every piece has a clear path to exit.

Navigating this arrow maze requires more than just random tapping; it demands critical thinking and strategy. You need to find the correct angle to help each arrow escape the grid without colliding with others. As you progress, the puzzle games evolve from simple warm-ups into complex IQ tests that truly challenge your spatial awareness and problem-solving skills.

Whether you are looking for a satisfying brain training session or a stress-free way to pass the time, this tap game fits the bill perfectly. With no timers to rush you, you can freely plan every move in this pure block puzzle experience. Master the logic behind the chaos, solve the jam, and ensure every arrow finds its way freedom.

🎮 How to Play:
• Tap the Arrows: Touch any arrow to send it flying off the screen.
• Watch the Direction: Arrows only move where the arrow points.
• Clear the Path: Plan your moves so arrows don't collide.
• Solve the Maze: Clear the entire grid to win!

⭐ Key Features:

🧠 Smart Logic Mechanics
Don't just tap—think! The board is a tangled grid of directional arrows. If you tap the wrong arrow, it might hit another block and bounce back. Finding the perfect order to clear the maze feels incredibly rewarding.

🏆 Levels That Grow With You
Start with easy grids to learn the ropes, then advance to intricate levels featuring millions of variations. The difficulty curves naturally, keeping the game accessible for beginners while offering deep challenges for puzzle veterans.

🎨 Minimalist & Satisfying Art
Enjoy a clean, colorful interface that is easy on the eyes. The smooth animations as arrows zoom off the screen provide a satisfying ASMR-like experience. It’s the perfect visual escape from a busy day.

🚫 No Stress, Just Play
Forget about ticking clocks or punishment for mistakes. Arrow Go is designed for relaxation. Take your time, analyze the puzzle board, and restart the level whenever you want to try a new strategy.

🌍 Play Offline Anytime
No Wi-Fi? No problem. Arrow Go is optimized for on-the-go play. Whether you are on a commute, traveling, or just relaxing at home, your brain workout is always ready.

🧩 Why play Arrow Go?
• Boost your IQ and spatial thinking.
• Satisfying "Tap Away" gameplay mechanics.
• Hundreds of handcrafted levels to solve.
• Perfect balance of relaxation and challenge.

Can you untangle the mess and clear every single arrow? Download Arrow Go now and start tapping your way to victory!

data.name: Flower Power: Blooming
data.description_full:
1. Game Rules
The core gameplay of Flower Power: The Art of Blooming revolves around matching and clearing tiles with identical patterns. Below the playing field, there is a slot that can hold up to 7 tiles. Clicking on a tile automatically places it into this slot. When 3 tiles with the same pattern are in the slot, they will be instantly cleared.

- Tip: You have a maximum of 7 moves per round to clear three tiles of the same design! If the slot fills up without matching three tiles, you lose. Every move counts!

- Layered Tiles: Some tiles may have multiple layers. Only after removing the top layer can you select and clear the lower layers.

- Winning Condition: Once no tiles remain on the board, you have successfully completed the level!

2. Game Features
Flower Power: The Art of Blooming offers a variety of features designed for players of all skill levels:

You cannot reason with the house.
You cannot fight The Obelisk.
You can only survive long enough to understand what it wants.

And if you are wrong, the house will keep you.

The Obelisk: Home Horror Game is a terrifying analog horror experience for players who want survival horror, VHS horror, and a nightmare built from familiar spaces turned hostile.

- Tap only lines that aren’t blocked
- The line slides out along its arrow direction
- You get 3 mistakes before the level ends
- Clear every line to complete the puzzle

- Minimal controls, real strategy: it’s all about sequence
- Quick, satisfying clears with a calm, focused vibe
- Great for short breaks—or long “one more try” sessions

💡🏆If you like puzzles that feel relaxing but demand precision, Arrow Explorer is your next obsession.

data.name: Titan Rush
data.description_full:
Волны поглотили цивилизацию, а Идзю разорвали наши дома. Мир повергнут в безмолвие, надежда покоится на дне океана. Выжившие, добро пожаловать в последнюю гавань — подводную базу. Это место ветхое, но безопасное; бедное, но полное жизни. Восстанавливайте оборудование, запускайте энергию, создавайте фермы. В этом подводном убежище из стали и воды мы вновь зажжём искру человечества. А в самой глубине базы дремлет гигантский мех, жаждущий пробуждения. Он станет клинком, что вернёт человечество на землю, и последним стражем в апокалипсисе.

[Перестройка базы: От выживания к возрождению]
Используйте каждое пространство, перезапустите каждое оборудование. От наладки базового энергоконтура до создания устойчивой подводной фермы, от расширения жилого квартала до запуска оружейного цеха — каждый шаг в строительстве решает вопрос жизни и смерти. Грамотное планирование схемы базы, разработка технологий апокалипсиса, усиление ресурсооборота — создание в морской бездне самодостаточной крепости.

[Восстановление меха: Глубинный клинок, рождённый для битвы]
Восстановите спящего гиганта и откройте комплексную систему вооружений — высокоэнергетические торпеды, импульсные орудия, глубинные резаки... Свободно комбинируйте оснащения под задачи боя и раскрывайте весь потенциал меха в реальных сражениях. Шквальным огнём сокрушайте стаи Идзю, а повышая манёвренность и ЗАЩ — готовьтесь к нашествию гигантских Идзю!

[Сбор командиров: Женская элита в строю]
В апокалипсисе они пришли на выручку со всех сторон. Логист, виртуозно управляющий ресурсами, Тактик, мастер внезапных рейдов, Инженер, специализирующийся на усилении мехов... Каждый командир привносит уникальные усиления для базы и меха. Грамотно комбинируя их таланты, создайте элитный отряд — живучий и могущественный. Вместе проложите путь сквозь бездну и руины к новому будущему.

[Исследуйте руины: Глубины таят, цивилизацию ищут]
Бывший город покоится под тёмными течениями, но в нём сокрыты и сокровища апокалипсиса. Сформируйте экспедиционный отряд и проникните в опасный город-руины. В поисках утраченных энергоядер, дефицитного снабжения, исчезнувших технологий... Каждое исследование может принести урожай, способный изменить всё, но грозит внезапной атакой глубоководных Идзю. Здесь риск и награда неразделимы.

[Альянс единства: Мы идём плечом к плечу]
Один в поле не воин. Бездне нужен отклик. Вступайте в альянс или создайте свой, чтобы совместно с другими выжившими делиться технологиями, обмениваться ресурсами и вести скоординированную оборону. Участвуйте в заданиях альянса, противостойте волнам гигантских Идзю и боритесь за стратегические глубинные зоны. Здесь ты не одинок во тьме. Вместе мы станем самой прочной линией обороны человечества в бездне.

>>Скачайте сейчас! Вернитесь на последнюю базу человечества<<

data.name: Color Juice ASMR
data.description_full:
Color Juice ASMR is a relaxing and satisfying sort puzzle game where flowing liquids and thoughtful logic come together. Designed for calm play sessions, the game delivers a smooth asmr experience that helps you unwind while keeping your mind engaged. With clean visuals and gentle animations, every level turns color juice into a relaxing visual reward.
In each stage, mixed liquids wait to be organized. Your goal is simple: use logic to match colors and complete a satisfying juice sort challenge. As puzzles grow more complex, the game transforms from a casual experience into a rewarding mental workout. Each sort puzzle is carefully crafted to feel fair, solvable, and deeply satisfying.
Whether you play for a few minutes or longer sessions, Color Juice ASMR offers pressure-free gameplay. No timers, no penalties—just calm asmr, smooth color juice flow, and steady progression through increasingly clever juice sort levels.

HOW TO PLAY:
The gameplay of Color Juice ASMR is easy to learn but challenging to master. Each level begins with several bottles filled with layered liquids. Your task is to solve a sort puzzle by organizing every color juice layer into the correct bottle.
Basic Rules
- Tap a bottle to pour liquid
- Liquids can only move when colors match
- Space must be available to continue a bottle fill
- Finish the juice sort when all colors are separated
These simple rules create surprising depth. Every match affects future moves, making each sort puzzle a test of planning rather than speed.
As levels progress, you’ll need to think ahead. Smart color sort decisions help you manage empty bottles, avoid blocked paths, and complete complex color puzzle layouts. A single wrong bottle fill can force you to rethink the entire solution.
Later levels introduce tighter layouts that demand careful planning. These advanced color puzzle stages reward patience, observation, and smart match sequencing.
WHY YOU'LL LOVE THIS GAME
Color Juice ASMR balances relaxation and challenge perfectly. The calm asmr feedback makes every bottle fill feel smooth and satisfying, while each juice sort puzzle keeps your brain engaged. Watching color juice settle correctly delivers a quiet sense of achievement.
The minimalist design keeps puzzles easy to read. Clean bottles, vibrant liquids, and smooth transitions make every color sort decision feel clear and intentional. Even difficult sort puzzle stages remain visually calm and approachable.
Despite its simplicity, the game offers real depth. Each level challenges you to match colors efficiently while managing limited space. Over time, you’ll recognize patterns, improve your strategy, and master the flow of color juice.
With many handcrafted levels, Color Juice ASMR is built for long-term enjoyment. Fans of juice sort, color sort, and relaxing color puzzle games will appreciate the polished mechanics and satisfying progression powered by smooth asmr moments.
data.description_short: Relax with color juice, enjoy ASMR flows, and solve satisfying sort puzzles

data.name: Berry Blast Pop
data.description_full:
Berry Blast Pop is a calming, mind-stimulating puzzle game crafted for pure stress relief. Unlike most match-3 titles, there are no harsh timers or ticking countdowns to rush you. Your objective is straightforward: tap any cluster of two or more identically colored blocks to wipe them away. String together bigger combos to rack up huge point totals!
How to Play
1. Tap, Match & Score: Tap any group of connected same-color blocks (either horizontally or vertically) to erase them and gain points with every clear.
2. Go Big for Bigger Rewards: The more blocks you eliminate with a single tap, the higher your combo score climbs—bigger clusters mean massive point boosts!
3. Clear the Grid to Conquer the Level: Each stage ends when no more connected same-color blocks are left on the board. Your final score will decide if you pass the level and unlock the next challenge.
Berry Blast Pop comes packed with countless levels that ramp up in difficulty step by step. To move forward, you’ll need to hit higher score goals as you take on more challenging later stages. Boasting a sleek, minimalist design and focused gameplay—no over-the-top distractions, just simple, deeply satisfying puzzle fun—it’s the ideal way to unwind and make the most of your free time.

Огромное количество уникальных карт, от извилистых троп до сложных лабиринтов, от открытых полей до неприступных ущелий — каждая битва ставит новую стратегическую задачу. Классический геймплей башенной защиты выведен на новый уровень: типы башен, комбинации навыков, пути улучшений и распределение ресурсов — каждое ваше решение меняет ход сражения. Испытайте свои пределы в режиме «Испытание Бездны», где бесконечные волны врагов проверят вашу оборону на прочность.

Искусство обороны — это не только защита, но и интеллектуальное противостояние с сильнейшими! От «Полигона Тактики», где проверяются основы, до «Небесного Рейтинга» для элиты и легендарной межсерверной лиги «Война Святилищ» — здесь создана целая экосистема для истинных стратегов. Покажите свой уникальный стиль защиты, изучите тактики лучших игроков мира и станьте мастером башенной обороны в битве стратегий.

Герои и оборона: стройте идеальную защитную систему
Герои — это не просто воины, а ключевые элементы вашей обороны! Легендарные герои открывают эксклюзивные навыки для башен, эпические герои дают уникальные усиления. Получите легендарного командира обороны при входе в игру, открывайте редких мастеров-строителей, проходя уровни. data.name: Horror Shawarma & Patience
data.description_full:
Horror Shawarma & Patience is a scary horror simulator where an ordinary job at a shawarma kiosk slowly turns into a disturbing psychological nightmare.

DAY — SHAWARMA KIOSK

By day, you are just a simple worker in a small shawarma kiosk.
You cook tasty shawarma, take orders, keep the place clean, throw out the trash, and try to grow your tiny business.
It’s a normal workday — just like millions of other workers live every day.

Many customers pass through your kiosk.
Some of them feel too strange, others are openly unsettling.
Someone stares for too long. Someone says inappropriate things.
Some customers come back again and again, smiling in a way that feels wrong.
What if they’re not even human?

But you endure it.
That’s work.
You need patience.
Nothing scary… right?

NIGHT — HORROR AND INSOMNIA

When the kiosk closes, a completely different game begins.

At night, the work simulator turns into true domestic psychological horror.
You can’t sleep. Strange sounds echo through your apartment. Shadows move.
Unsettling visions follow you from room to room.

You keep doing everyday things — cooking food, cleaning, trying to relax —
but fear slowly crawls into your mind.
Your patience starts to fade, and it feels like you’re losing your grip on reality.

DON’T WATCH TOO LONG

You decide to face the fear and understand what’s happening.
You walk to the window and grab your binoculars.
Lights are on in the building across the street.
Clearly, you’re not the only one awake tonight.

Your patience — is running out, and you start watching your neighbors.
First out of curiosity.
Then out of anxiety.

But don’t watch for too long.
What begins as patience can turn into obsession —
and obsession can turn into a real nightmare.

The longer you look, the scarier it becomes.
Ordinary scenes twist into something horrifying.
And the feeling that someone is watching you back never goes away.

How do you survive until morning
just to return to another shift at the shawarma kiosk?

GAME FEATURES
- Shawarma kiosk work simulator
- Strange and terrifying visitors
- Psychological horror and everyday fear
- Watching mechanics and growing paranoia
- Atmosphere of anxiety, exhaustion, and insomnia
- Slow transformation of routine into a nightmare
- A constant test of your terpenie and sanity

This is a game about work, watching, and consequences.
About patience that slowly breaks.
About a nightmare that begins when you think everything is under control.

Download Horror Shawarma & Patience and try to survive the night.

data.description_full:
Craftarena: Minicraft Block Craft Game 3D is a globally recognized sandbox experience that invites players into a vast pixel-based universe built around creativity, exploration, and survival. Designed for freedom and imagination, this block-style world lets players shape their own journey in countless ways.

Vast Procedural World
The world of Craftarena: Minicraft Block Craft Game 3D is massive and procedurally generated, offering an endless array of landscapes to explore. Explore dense forests, high mountains, deep underground caves, and wide oceans. Every new area feels unique, making exploration an essential and rewarding part of the experience.

Build Without Limits
At the heart of the game lies its signature block-based craft system. Players can design simple shelters or complex structures, shape entire environments, and bring ideas to life block by block. From artistic builds to functional designs, creativity has no boundaries.

Survival Challenge
MiniCraft Craftarena Block Survival mode puts players to the test. Gather resources, craft tools, and manage hunger while defending against hostile creatures. The dynamic day-and-night cycle adds tension, as nighttime introduces more dangerous enemies and unexpected threats.

Unlimited Creative Freedom
Creative mode removes all limits by providing unlimited resources and free flight. This mode is ideal for players who want to focus entirely on building and experimentation without worrying about survival mechanics or enemy encounters. So, enjoy the endless minicraft: block game as much.

Multiplayer Experience
With multiplayer support, Craftarena minicraft carft game becomes a shared adventure. Team up with friends to build large projects, explore together, or compete in exciting player-versus-player encounters. Multiplayer gameplay adds strong social interaction and replay value.

Resource Collection, Crafting and Building
Mining and craft mechanics form the core gameplay loop. Players collect ores, minerals, and materials from the world and use them to craft tools, weapons, armor, and useful items through an intuitive crafting and building grid system.

Enchantments & Potions
Advanced systems like enchanting and brewing unlock as players progress. Enhance tools and weapons with special abilities or brew potions to gain advantages, adding depth and long-term goals to gameplay.

Living World of Creatures
The Craftarena crafting and building world is filled with a wide range of mobs and creatures, each with unique behaviors and challenges. Players must adapt their strategies to survive encounters with these enemies.

Biomes & Alternate Realms
Different biomes bring varied environments, climates, and resources. Beyond the main world, mysterious dimensions introduce new challenges, enemies, and rewards that expand the adventure further.

Redstone & Automation
Redstone enables players to build complex systems and machines. From simple switches to advanced automated contraptions, this feature introduces logic-based building and engineering possibilities.

In essence, Craftarena: minicraft block game combines open-ended craft mechanics, deep survival gameplay, and exploration within a constantly evolving block world. Whether playing solo or with others, players are free to create, survive, and explore in a universe where imagination sets the only limit.

For those who prefer an unrestricted experience, Creative mode provides infinite resources and the ability to fly, letting players build grand creations without worrying about resource gathering or dangerous mobs.

4. Mining and Crafting:
The heart of the gameplay revolves around mining resources like ores and minerals to craft useful items, tools, and weapons. The crafting system is straightforward, allowing players to combine items in a crafting grid.

5. Redstone Engineering:
Redstone, a special resource, allows players to design complex machinery, circuits, and automated systems. From simple traps to elaborate devices, redstone engineering introduces a technical side to the game.

6. Survival Mode:
In Survival mode, players must gather resources, craft essential tools, and defend themselves from hostile mobs. The changing day and night cycles introduce new challenges, with nighttime bringing more dangerous enemies.

7. Multiplayer Features:
Craftarena’s multiplayer mode enables players to collaborate or compete with friends and other players. Whether building together or engaging in player-versus-player combat, it adds a social and competitive element to the game.

8. Enchanting and Brewing:
As players advance, they can enchant weapons and tools to give them special abilities, or brew potions to improve their survival. These deeper mechanics add long-term goals and variety to gameplay.

9. Biomes and Dimensions:
The game world is divided into several biomes, each with unique climates, vegetation, and terrain. Players can also venture into mystical dimensions like the Nether and the End, where they’ll face new challenges and reap rich rewards.

10. Mobs and Creatures:
Craftarena’s world is filled with a range of creatures, from the infamous Creeper to Endermen and more. Each mob introduces unique challenges, requiring players to adjust their strategies and tactics to survive.

In summary, the allure of Minicraft Block Craftarena 3D lies in its combination of open-ended creativity, survival challenges, exploration, and a thriving multiplayer community. Whether you're playing solo or with friends, the possibilities in this vast, blocky world are truly endless.

data.name: Hexa Combooo!
data.description_full:
Step into Hexa Combooo!, a relaxed puzzle game where smooth strategy meets a satisfying sense of flow.
If you enjoy creating combos at your own pace and watching the board clear away, this is a puzzle you can truly settle into.




The gameplay is easy to understand:


1. Each turn, you receive three hexagonal pieces.

2. Place them anywhere on the board.

3. Matching colors merge into the last piece you placed.

4. When a merged group grows beyond 10 pieces, it clears from the board in a clean, satisfying pop.




Your goal is to keep clearing pieces and reach the level target.
It’s simple to start, but choosing where to place each piece — and when to build toward a larger combo — gives the game its depth.




◆ FIND YOUR FLOW ◆

Enjoy the steady rhythm of placing, merging, and clearing.
Each move naturally leads to the next, creating a smooth loop that feels calm and focused.
It’s easy to relax and stay in the zone.




◆ SATISFYING COMBO MOMENTS ◆

Careful planning lets you set up larger chain reactions over time.
One well-placed piece can trigger a series of merges and clears, turning the board lighter and cleaner in a single moment.
Those quiet “Combooo!” moments are what make the game so enjoyable.




◆ DESIGNED FOR RELAXED PLAY ◆

Hexa Combooo! is built for stress-free puzzle sessions.

✓ No timers: Play at your own comfortable pace.

✓ No harsh penalties: Take your time and adjust your strategy.

✓ Calm progression: Focus on the puzzle, not pressure.




KEY FEATURES:

  • Easy to learn, with room for thoughtful placement

  • Combo-based clearing that feels smooth and rewarding

  • Clean, colorful visuals that are easy on the eyes

  • A wide range of levels with varied goals

  • Offline play, anytime and anywhere



Ready to relax and start clearing?

Download Hexa Combooo! and enjoy the simple pleasure of well-planned combos.

data.name: Minicraft: Block Craft 3D
data.description_full:
Welcome to Minicraft: Block Craft 3D!

Minicraft: Block Craft 3D is a professional sandbox adventure game that allows players to explore a vast block-based world filled with creativity, survival challenges, and endless possibilities. It is designed for players who enjoy crafting, building, and discovering new environments.

1. Open World Exploration
The game features a large, procedurally generated open world where every area feels unique. Players can explore forests, mountains, caves, deserts, and oceans, making each journey exciting and unpredictable.

2. Creative Building System
With its flexible block-based building system, players can construct anything they imagine. From simple houses to massive cities and detailed structures, creativity has no limits.

3. Survival Mode Challenges
In Survival mode, players must collect resources, craft tools, and defend themselves against hostile creatures. The day and night cycle increases difficulty, as enemies become more dangerous after sunset.

4. Creative Mode Freedom
Creative mode provides unlimited resources and the ability to fly. This mode is perfect for players who want to focus entirely on building and design without survival restrictions.

5. Mining and Crafting Mechanics
Mining plays a central role in the game. Players gather ores and materials to craft tools, weapons, armor, and other useful items using an easy-to-learn crafting system.

6. Enchanting and Brewing Systems
As players progress, they can unlock enchanting and potion brewing features. These systems enhance tools and equipment with special abilities, improving survival and exploration.

7. Mobs and Creatures
The world is filled with a variety of mobs, each with unique behaviors and challenges. Players must adjust their strategies to survive encounters with different creatures.

8. Biomes and Special Dimensions
Multiple biomes offer diverse landscapes, climates, and resources. Special dimensions introduce rare items, tougher enemies, and exciting new adventures.

9. Redstone Engineering
The redstone system allows players to create automated machines, traps, and mechanisms. From basic switches to advanced circuits, it adds depth and creativity to gameplay.

10. Multiplayer Experience
Multiplayer mode enables players to connect, collaborate, or compete with others. Build together, explore new areas, or engage in PvP battles for a more social gaming experience.

In essence, Minicraft: Block Craft 3D stands out through its perfect balance of creative freedom, open-world exploration, and engaging survival challenges. Supported by an active and growing community, the game continues to evolve with new possibilities. Whether you choose to play alone or team up with friends, the blocky world offers endless opportunities for fun and imagination.

data.name: CapsyPop - Brain Puzzle Game
data.description_full:
CapsyPop is an original memory, skill, and strategy game set inside a charming capsule machine full of surprises.

Each level challenges your focus and quick thinking with delicious puzzles that grow increasingly complex.
Create matches of 2, 3, or even 4 elements to release capsules, reveal clues, open surprise eggs, or break boxes to clear space.

Boxes may contain balloons to pop, powerful capsules… or the dreaded poison, which makes capsules grow and increases the pressure of the level.
Some capsules are locked — find the key and avoid the poison to keep progressing.

Your goal is simple: clear the machine by solving every puzzle, level by level, while expanding your collections and earning cups.

Collect capsules and grow your collection

Each completed level rewards you with a spin of the machine, granting a surprise capsule filled with collectible items such as:

- Fruits
- Sweets
- Fast food
- Sushi
- Ice cream
- Backery

…and many more coming soon.

Your collection grows as you advance through the game.

Unique challenges in every level

Throughout your journey, you’ll encounter a wide variety of challenges, including:

- Bee hives
- Chocolates
- Delicious waffles
- Chocolate eggs
- Candy bars
- Bonbon boxes
- Bunches of grapes
- Jars
- Balloon-filled boxes
- Classic painting puzzles
- Jumping frogs
- Moving birds
- Restless butterflies

...and more.

Each one adds a fresh twist and keeps every level feeling new.

Special power-ups from streaks

Achieve three correct matches in a row and a special capsule will drop, granting a unique power-up such as lightning, hammers, vines, and other magical effects that help you clear tough situations.

Building streaks — and knowing when to use each power-up — is key to progressing.

Global cup system and progress tracking

Earn up to three cups per level based on your performance.
Your total cups determine your position in the global ranking.

Track your progress through a visual pathway inside the capsule machine, showing your position compared to the leader and the global average for your level.

Main features

- Hundreds of sweet, colorful, and varied levels
- A unique blend of memory, skill, strategy, and physics
- Surprise capsules with multiple collectibles
- Special power-ups earned through streaks
- Animated and dynamic challenges
- Works offline
- Soft, colorful, and charming art style

data.name: 라스트 라이트
data.description_full:
언데드에게 황폐해진 세상, 인류의 마지막 희망이 폐허의 그림자 속에서 희미하게 타오르는 이 세상에서, 당신은 인류 최후의 항전을 이끌어낼 영웅이 될 수 있을까요? 멸망의 위협 속에서 전략과 의지를 시험하는 궁극의 도전, 라스트 라이트에 오신 것을 환영합니다.

선 그리기 및 저장
손가락으로 선을 그려 즉시 방어벽을 만들고 귀여운 강아지들을 몬스터의 공격으로부터 보호하세요. 각 레벨마다 날아다니는 박쥐부터 굴러오는 바위까지 새로운 도전이 기다리고 있습니다. 과연 당신은 최고의 강아지 영웅이 될 수 있을까요?

건설 및 방어
종말의 한복판에 요새를 건설하세요. 견고한 성벽을 쌓고, 필수 자원 기지를 설치하고, 첨단 기술을 개발하여 끊임없이 몰려오는 언데드 무리를 막아내세요. 당신이 짓는 모든 건물과 강화하는 모든 방어 시설은 생존과 멸망을 가르는 중요한 요소가 될 것입니다.

관리 및 적응
각기 다른 기술, 특성, 그리고 어려움을 지닌 생존자 공동체를 이끌어 나가세요. 역할을 분담하고, 사기를 관리하고, 생사를 가르는 결정을 내려 당신의 안식처를 지켜내세요. 하지만 조심하세요. 이 파괴된 세상에서 위험은 외부에서만 오는 것이 아닙니다.

탐험과 탈환
옛 세계의 폐허 속으로 탐험대를 보내세요. 보급품을 찾고, 숨겨진 역사를 밝혀내고, 다른 생존자들을 만나세요. 어떤 이들은 기꺼이 도움을 주려 하고, 어떤 이들은 배신하려 들 것입니다. 영향력을 확장하고, 잃어버린 영토를 되찾고, 대재앙의 배후에 숨겨진 어두운 비밀을 밝혀내세요.

동맹과 지배
전 세계 플레이어들과 동맹을 맺으세요. 공격을 조율하고, 자원을 공유하고, 힘을 합쳐 좀비 무리와 적대 세력을 물리치세요. 함께라면 단순한 피난처가 아닌, 새로운 문명을 건설할 수 있습니다.

세상의 종말은 단지 시작일 뿐입니다. 당신은 그저 살아남을 것인가… 아니면 인류를 새로운 시대로 이끌 것인가?

By peeling back layers systematically and avoiding dead ends, your objective is to clear every single tile from the board to solve the logic puzzle and master the challenge.

- 🏆 Progressive Difficulty – Starts easy to help you learn the logic, then ramps up to complex, multi-layered structures that will truly test your patience and skill.

data.name: NTE: Neverness to Everness
data.description_full:
NTE is a supernatural open-world RPG developed by Hotta Studio. The story begins in the city of Hethereau, where you play as its first "unlicensed" Anomaly Hunter. You'll join the crew at Eibon, a rundown antique shop that keeps the lights on by taking Anomaly commissions from anyone willing to pay. Alongside a diverse cast of extraordinary companions, you'll unravel urban mysteries, ride out adventures full of laughs and heartbreak, and write your own stories in the neon-lit streets.

◆ Strange City, Strange Adventures

Welcome to the first stop in your appraisal career—Hethereau, a sprawling and vibrant metropolis!

In the crowded halls of the Bureau of Anomaly Control, hopeful Oddities queue up for resident permits, while over at the train station, an Esper commuter snaps his fingers to clean his work suit on the fly. Down one block, a chaotic chase after Danzaburou is spiraling out of control; while across the street, a vacationing silver-gloved Butler is shooting the breeze with the owner of a second-hand electronics shop. Everywhere you look, there's no shortage of intriguingly "abnormal" scenes.

Want to dive deeper into a world where humans and the supernatural coexist? Start your journey in Hethereau to see it for yourself. The lively and quirky daily life here is a grand adventure in itself.

◆ Interesting Stories, Lighthearted Connections

Today's Top Story: Rumors are swirling about a mysterious pawnshop that only appears on the night of the full moon. What would you trade for a wish?

Breaking News: Taygedo's romance crisis! Romance and impulse, heartbreak and missed chances—Miss Tako, the object of a secret crush, is about to leave Hethereau with her guarantor. How will the lovestruck otter get his feelings across before it's too late?

Reliable Insider Tip: Film Orbit Studio is back in business! Members of the Eibon Antique Shop get exclusive discounts!

Weather Update: The Anomaly Rainman is entering an active phase—don't forget your rain gear on the way out!

That wraps up today's 10AM broadcast. Stay tuned for mysterious Anomalies, unbreakable "Oaths," and the ever-growing shadow of the colossal "Circle" organization, looming larger in the fragmented echoes of "Prophecies"...

◆ Encounters and Bonds

Explore hidden shops tucked away in back alleys and meet their enigmatic owners, along with absurdly overpowered bodyguards, "jack-of-all-trades" robotic butlers, troublemakers who can't help finding problems, and TV-headed repairmen with some very curious eating habits.

As part of the Eibon crew, you'll never be short on energetic companions for the road ahead.

Expand your social circle starting from the bustling Hankaku Street! Meet members from different factions and add them as "Bagel" friends!

From the tight-knit neighborhood of street shops to the city's unique hunter organizations, countless side stories await—ready for you to make friends and forge bonds across every corner of Hethereau.

◆ Customize Your Urban Lifestyle

Explore the city on your own terms—stick to familiar routines or shake things up.

Customize your ride and tear through the city streets, or hop on the Ghost Train to cut through Anomaly space and arrive in a flash.

In your downtime, swing by the old shops on Hankaku Street to browse their secret seasonal stock, or buy a cozy little home and deck it out to your liking.

Go at your own pace, follow your instincts, and let Hethereau reward you with colorful days worth remembering.

The sun set long ago in the world you knew, leaving behind only the ink-stained silence of the discarded. Welcome to the grey between life and loss—a sketchbook of crumbling brick and forgotten dust where the architecture is as hungry as the ghosts. You are a Scavenger, a flickering candle in a forest of grey, rummaging through the ribcages of dead buildings to reclaim the scrap of the past. But beware: every hallway is a throat waiting to swallow you whole, and every shadow has a name.
Escape the ruins... or become part of them.

THE LOOP: SEARCH. FIGHT. ESCAPE.
The rules of the ruin are simple but deadly. Enter the zone, fill your pockets with relic scrap, and find the extraction point before the clock strikes midnight.
• Scavenge the Shadows: Rummage through the rot of schools, hospitals, and houses to find the materials you need.
• Banish the Residents: Use ancient exorcist tools to fight back the ghouls that haunt the halls.
• The Final Run: If you don't reach the exit in time, the ruins will claim you—and everything you’ve gathered—forever.

CRAFT YOUR CURSE: Roguelike Combat
No two descents into the dark are the same. As you battle through the corridors, the ghosts you defeat grant you flickering memories of power.
• Triple-Threat Evolution: Choose between three twisted power-ups in the heat of battle to evolve your survival.
• Synergize to Survive: Will you focus on blinding light, serrated steel, or protective charms? Your build is the only thing between you and a permanent stay in the ward.

ARSENAL OF THE EXORCIST
With over 50 unique Talismanic Tools to collect, your playstyle is yours to define. From rusted ritual blades to spectral lanterns, every tool features a deep Perk Tree.

SHELTER OF SCRAP: Camp Operation
You aren't the only one trapped in the grey. Deep within the ruins, you’ll find "The Broken"—hostages of the haunts who are waiting for a savior.
• Rescue & Rebuild: Bring survivors back to your camp to unlock specialized shops and powerful services.
• Management of the Macabre: Your camp is your only sanctuary. Use your extracted loot to fortify your home and prepare for the next night.

GAME FEATURES:
• Gothic Hand-Drawn Art: A beautiful eerie world inspired by classic lite-horror sketches.
• High-Stakes Extraction: The thrill of "Search-Fight-Extract" compressed into bite-sized, casual sessions.
• Urban Exploration (Urbex): Explore 8+ distinct environments, from the Hollow High School to the Echoing Offices.
• Endless Variety: Dozens of heroes to unbind and hundreds of weapon/perk combinations to master.

THE RUINS ARE CALLING. WILL YOU ANSWER, OR WILL YOU FADE?

data.name: Myth Black Monkey: Return
data.description_full:
Five centuries ago, the Havoc in Heaven was nothing but a destined gambit orchestrated by the combined forces of Mount Ling and the Celestial Court; five centuries later, the Golden Fillet is reborn, setting you on an inevitable path against heaven to seek the truth. In this dark world where gods and buddhas wear masks of benevolence and demons wail in sorrow, you—the Destined One—shall inherit the fragmented will of the Great Sage Equal to Heaven. You will cross paths with demon kings, fallen deities, old friends and new foes alike, shatter the shackles of reincarnation, and reclaim the name of "Wukong" that was erased from existence.
As a 3D action roleplaying game, we have deeply reconstructed the dark mythological core to immerse you in a tragic epic of "ending war through war." Confront the lies woven by gods and buddhas, and reforge the indomitable will of the demon monkey.

【Return to the Three Realms, Traverse Tribulation Realms】
From the miasmashrouded Black Wind Mountain to the ruined walls of Yellow Wind Ridge, from the snowcovered Little Western Heaven to the flamescorched Flame Mountain—every familiar land conceals the bloody truth of the pilgrimage! Beneath the compassionate facade of Guanyin Temple lies the dark art of immortality; the countless threads of emotion in Silkweb Cave entangle the filthy dealings of gods and buddhas; the rhythmic Sanskrit of Little Thunderclap Temple is but mindbewitching demonic sorcery. Why did the former pilgrim become but an empty shell of the Victorious Fighting Buddha? What truly lies buried beneath the Ruyi Jingu Bang—demons, or unyielding souls who refused to submit? Embark on this journey to find your roots and uncover the ultimate truth behind the erasure of "Wukong"!

【Eastern Aesthetics, Dark Mythology Reborn】
Built with Unreal Engine 5's realistic dark art style, with 3D scanning restoring the essence of ancient Chinese architecture—crumbling temples with flying eaves and dougong brackets, mosscovered giant buddha statues, grotesque sculptures where flesh and stone intertwine. Every scene speaks of the corruption of gods and buddhas and the tragic beauty of the demonic. Fur rendering technology captures the primal intensity of the ape; particle effects reconstruct the chaotic energy of the seventytwo transformations. The core theme of "through demonic eyes, witnessing the evil of gods" permeates throughout, immersing you in the weight of staff strikes whistling through air and the sorrow of falling deities.

【Combination Combos, Hardcore Combat Experience】
Innovative core combat system featuring Combination Combos, effortlessly executing fluid chains and screenshaking impact sensations. Paired with divine abilities and spells, every clash becomes an extreme test of strategy and reflex. Hidden boss battles await—face former celestial allies and pilgrimage companions fallen into demonhood, comprehending their obsessions and sorrows through lifeanddeath duels! Beyond core combat, discover diverse gameplay including the Shadow God Index research, environmental narrative puzzles, and magical treasure collection and refinement, satisfying all exploration desires!

【Demons Rising, Together on the Path to Truth】
Encounter Zhu Bajie's decadent cunning, Sha Wujing's silent ferocity, the Bull Demon King's tragic final song, the Spider Spirit's entanglement in emotional tribulation... Hundreds of mythological characters reappear in twisted or tragic forms, where the line between good and evil blurs and each harbors their own obsessions and secrets. You will battle or ally with them, witnessing dark tales of fraternal strife, estranged friendships, and deicide to prove the Way. Unlock fragmentary narratives in the Shadow God Index. By collecting the Six Roots and reforging the Great Sage's memories, resonate with these souls crushed by destiny, and together embark on this heavendefying journey to reclaim the name of "Wukong"!

data.description_full:
Annoying Uncle: Punch and Slap

Annoying Uncle: Punch and Slap is a super cool action game where you are the boss. It is time to have some fun and teach your uncle a lesson. Are you ready to wiggle your arm and deliver the perfect hit?

🎮 How to Play This Awesome Game

Playing is super easy! You have a stretchy, rubbery arm that can reach anywhere.

1. Touch on the screen to aim your hand.
2. Release.
3. Smack the target to win!

🥊 Use Your Best Moves
You have so many ways to play. Do you like sports? Then use your boxing skills! Put on your gloves and deliver a super strong punch. When you land a good punch, the uncle will fly across the room like a ragdoll. It looks so funny!

Do you want to be like a spider superhero? Use your web shooter! Aim carefully and throw a sticky web to trap him. The web sticks him to the wall so he can't move. It is the coolest way to stop him from talking!

Maybe you want to be an adventurer? Grab your whip! Crack the whip to reach him from far away. The whip is super fast and makes a cool snapping sound. If he is bending over to pick something up, you can even give him a funny spank with your hand!

🌟 So Many Cool Levels

There are tons of levels for you to explore!

The 6 7 Level: The uncle is trying to do the famous ""6 7"" meme. It looks terrible! Throw your punch at the right beat to stop his dancing.

Aura Farming Level: He thinks he has +1000 Aura and is acting super cool. Don't let him farm aura! Use your whip to bring his coolness down to zero.

Squid Game Level: It is Red Light, Green Light time!

In the early levels, he stands still. But be careful! In later levels, he starts moving. He hides behind tables, chairs, and lamps. You have to be a master of action to catch him. You will need to curve your arm and throw your punch around corners.

🏆 Unlock Funny Stuff

As you play the game, you win coins. You can use these coins to buy awesome upgrades!

Crazy Gloves: change your boxing gloves to spider man hands or hulk hands!
Silly Weapons: Instead of a hand, try using a whip to smack him!

🤣 Why You Will Love It

This is the ultimate action game for when you are bored. The physics are crazy! When you throw a punch, the arm wiggles and wobbles. When you land a smack, the furniture breaks and things go flying.

The annoying uncle thinks he is safe, but he is wrong! You are the champion of boxing and slapping. He will try to run, he will try to hide, but your punch will always find him.

Challenge your friends! Who can beat the hardest levels? Who can get the highest score? Who can deliver the funniest punch?

🚀 Download Now!

Are you ready for the laughs? Grab your phone and download Annoying Uncle: Punch and Slap right now! It is free, it is fun, and it is full of action.

Don’t let him get away with his bad jokes. Throw your arm, aim your punch, and let the fun begin. Whether you want to box, slap, smack, or spank, this is the game for you!

Relentless Pursuer
The evil spirit grows stronger with every step you take. At first, she lurks in silence. But soon, she will hunt you.

Dynamic Scares
Expect the unexpected: chilling jumpscares, shifting environments, and haunting events that evolve as the night progresses.

Tense Stealth & Chase Sequences
Hide when you can. Run when you must. Your choices—and your speed—will decide whether you survive.

Cultural Horror Rooted in Indian
Experience a setting rarely explored in horror games, with Indian themed story rich horror game with Hindi dialogues and English Subtitles

Multiple Difficulty Modes
Whether you’re here for the story or a punishing survival challenge, choose from Easy, Medium, or Hard.

Authentic Voice Acting
Fully voiced in Hindi, with English subtitles for global accessibility and immersion.

Every locked drawer hides a secret. Every note tells the story of those who came before you. Every wrong turn brings you closer to the spirit that guards these halls. Midnight approaches, and time is running out.

Will you save your friends—or join the ones who never escaped?

The world has turned to ash, dominated by zombies. Z Route—it is your final path to redemption, and the last battleground of the apocalypse. With nowhere to hide, you can only advance, weapon ready! Redemption or doom? The choice is in your hands!​​
​Crash through every gate of choice and tear through the horde amid roaring engines. Only speed and ruthlessness will keep you alive. Are you ready? This is your war.

​- Trust Your Alliance​
In an apocalypse, no one survives alone. Recruit warriors with different specialties and build the ultimate squad. Strategy and teamwork are your only path to survival.
- ​Choose Wisely​
Every gate is a gamble between life and death. Choose right, and you'll find supplies. Choose wrong, and face the horde. Time is short, so you must decide fast. ​Only the smartest and toughest will achieve redemption!​​
​- Arm Yourself​
The stronger your weapon, the better your chances. But fate is fickle; survival also depends on luck.
​- Speedrun Stages​
Speed is your shield. Dash, dodge, counter—don't stop! Only by pushing forward can you keep death at bay.

data.name: Voxel Blast Jam
data.description_full:
🧩 Voxel Blast Jam – Block Puzzle Shooter

Voxel Blast Jam is a block puzzle shooter game that combines classic block puzzle mechanics with shooter-style gameplay. The game is designed around logic, planning, and spatial thinking rather than speed or reflex-based actions.

There is no timer and no time limit. Each level can be played at your own pace, allowing players to focus on puzzle solving and strategy without countdown mechanics.

🎯 Puzzle Shooter Gameplay
At its core, Voxel Blast Jam blends block blast puzzle mechanics with a color block shooter structure. Players aim, shoot, and clear colorful voxel blocks by forming matches and planning efficient moves. Each level introduces new layouts and challenges that encourage careful decision-making.

The gameplay supports both casual block puzzle play and more strategic block puzzle approaches. Whether progressing step by step or planning multiple moves ahead, the block shooter puzzle game adapts to different play styles.

🎨 Colorful Voxel Design
Every level is built from colorful voxel blocks, creating a clear and readable voxel block puzzle experience. The visual style follows a pixel art puzzle approach, focusing on structure and clarity rather than visual clutter. This makes it easier to track block positions and plan future moves.

Voxel Blast Jam also fits naturally into the voxel puzzle game category, offering consistent visual language across levels and environments.

🧠 Logic and Strategy Focus
Voxel Blast Jam is designed as a logic block puzzle where planning is more important than reaction speed. Inspired by grid puzzle game formats such as 8x8 block puzzle and 1010 block puzzle, the game emphasizes placement, space management, and long-term strategy.

Players can trigger combo blast puzzle interactions by setting up connected clears and chain reactions. These mechanics reward thoughtful positioning and pattern recognition within the puzzle grid.

🌿 Flexible Play Sessions
The game can be played offline and includes no wifi puzzle game support, making it suitable for uninterrupted sessions. With one finger puzzle controls and a slow paced puzzle structure, gameplay remains comfortable across short or extended play sessions.

There are no forced interruptions, timers, or competitive pressure elements built into the core experience.

🔁 Flow and Sorting Mechanics
Voxel Blast Jam includes gameplay elements inspired by flow puzzle, loop puzzle, color sorting, and sort puzzle mechanics. Players familiar with color match, color jam, and sorting games will recognize these patterns within a puzzle shooter format.

The structure supports steady progression through increasingly complex puzzles, allowing players to engage with the logic and layout of each level.

Voxel Blast Jam is suitable for players looking for a puzzle shooter game focused on logic, structure, and consistent gameplay systems. It combines block puzzle mechanics, shooter-style interaction, and voxel-based design into a single, cohesive experience.

data.name: Yarn Loop
data.description_full:
Yarn Loop is a relaxing and satisfying puzzle game featuring colorful yarn bobbins and knitted patterns.

Bobbins move onto the conveyor and collect stitches of their own color. Each bobbin has a capacity value that decreases as stitches are picked up. When its capacity reaches zero, the bobbin disappears. If capacity remains, the bobbin is transferred to the rack and can be used again later.

Complete each knitted pattern by using the right bobbins in the right order.

Game Features
► Simple One-Tap Gameplay: Bobbins move smoothly through the conveyor system and collect matching stitches with ease.
► Color-Based Collection Mechanic: Each bobbin clears only the stitches of its own color.
► Capacity Management System: Every bobbin has a limited pickup value, creating thoughtful and satisfying puzzle decisions.
► Rack Reuse Function: Bobbins that still have capacity return to the rack and remain available for later use.
► Hundreds of Engaging Levels: New knitted layouts, color combinations, and puzzle arrangements appear throughout progression.
► Cozy Yarn Aesthetic: Soft textures, warm colors, and pleasant animations create a calm and enjoyable experience.

Yarn Loop offers a smooth, calm, and visually charming journey through handcrafted yarn puzzles.

data.name: Haunted Merge
data.description_full:
Вы сирота. Странствующий мастер фэншуй нашёл вас неподалёку от кладбища совсем крохой и воспитал как родное дитя. Перед смертью он передал вам запертую шкатулку — единственную нить, ведущую к вашему прошлому. После его похорон вы отправляетесь на поиски истины.
Первая зацепка приводит вас к ветхому многоквартирному дому. Вы вселяетесь в одну из его квартир и вскоре понимаете, что с ним что-то не так...
- Лифт открывается сам по себе, на этажах, где никого нет.
- В пустых коридорах слышен потусторонний шёпот.
- На проклятой стройке снова и снова гибнут люди...
Вы думаете, что попали в историю о призраках, но со временем осознаёте: всё намного страшнее.
Ведь истинный ужас вселяют не мёртвые, а живые.

Особенности игры:
Посмотрите в глаза своим страхам и раскройте тайны далёкого прошлого.
Объединяйте улики, чтобы приблизиться к истине.
Будьте внимательны: любая мелочь может оказаться важной зацепкой.
Решайте головоломки, погрузившись в неповторимую атмосферу этой таинственной истории.

Хотите докопаться до правды?
Ваши родители исчезли. Но как? Почему?
Это проклятие или тщательно скрываемый обман?
Как понять, что реально, а что нет?
Столько смертей... Несчастные случаи или нечто гораздо хуже?

Это игра для тех, кто:
- любит мистику и страшные истории,
- ищет что-то необычное в жанре объединения предметов,
- интересуется сюжетами о тёмной стороне человеческой природы.
Это ваш единственный выход.

Скачайте Haunted Merge: Horror Story.
Объединяйте улики. Узнайте правду.
Раскройте тайну каждой леденящей душу истории, которую им не удалось предать забвению.

Facebook:
https://www.facebook.com/hauntedmerge
